title: RELAY: Scaling Historical Build Restoration through Rule Reuse and Agentic Repair
title_zh: RELAY：通过规则复用与智能体修复实现历史构建恢复的规模化

paragraphs.en: Vulnerability benchmarks and software engineering research depend on rebuilding historical software. Yet builds rely on external resources, such as base images and packages, that change independently of the source code. In this study, we examine this environment decay on 14,159 OSS-Fuzz cases. We find that 69.7% no longer complete reconstruction and verification, and that most failures share a small number of recurring failure symptoms. A recurring failure can therefore be diagnosed once and its repair reused. We present Relay , a hybrid framework that uses an LLM to derive and validate deterministic repair rules from representative failures, reuses them without model calls, and escalates cases unresolved by rules to a per-case agent. We evaluate Relay in human-guided and fully automated rule-derivation campaigns and compare it with a per-case agent approach. We find that rule derivation can be fully automated, and that reusable rules restore as many builds as per-case agents with fewer build executions. However, agents restore cases that the rules cannot. Our results show that a hybrid approach that applies rules first and escalates the remaining cases to an agent restores more builds than either approach alone and at a lower cost than using agents alone.

paragraphs.en: Rebuilding an earlier version of a software system is necessary for reproducing reported bugs, bisecting regressions, and evaluating tools on historical defects. This need is especially visible in vulnerability research. For instance, ARVO reconstructs vulnerable and fixed versions of OSS-Fuzz projects ( Mei et al., 2026 ) and benchmarks such as CyberGym and SEC-bench depend on executable historical software ( Wang et al., 2026 ; Lee et al., 2025 ) . If a case no longer builds, its vulnerability and any proposed repair cannot be evaluated through execution. Researchers must instead exclude the case or rely on indirect measures such as code similarity, which may not reflect whether a patch actually fixes the vulnerability ( Zhang et al., 2026 ) .
paragraphs.zh: 重建软件系统的早期版本对于复现已报告的缺陷、对回归进行二分定位以及在历史缺陷上评估工具是必不可少的。 这一需求在漏洞研究中尤为明显。 例如，ARVO 重建了 OSS-Fuzz 项目的易受攻击版本和已修复版本（Mei et al., 2026），而 CyberGym 和 SEC-bench 等基准测试依赖于可执行的历史软件（Wang et al., 2026；Lee et al., 2025）。 如果某个案例无法再构建，其漏洞以及任何提出的修复方案都无法通过执行来评估。 研究者只能转而排除该案例，或依赖代码相似度等间接度量，而这些度量可能无法反映补丁是否真正修复了漏洞（Zhang et al., 2026）。

paragraphs.en: Rebuilding historical software is often much harder than checking out its source code. Build instructions may remain available, but they depend on resources that change independently of the target project. Base images are retired, package repositories remove old versions, toolchain installers move, and third-party download URLs disappear ( Nourry et al., 2025 ; Mei et al., 2026 ; Malka et al., 2026 ) . A build can therefore fail years later even though its target source revision has not changed. We refer to failures caused by such changes as environment decay . Developers generally maintain the current version of a project rather than restore every historical release, leaving this work to the researchers and benchmark maintainers who depend on those releases.
paragraphs.zh: 重建历史软件往往比检出其源代码难得多。 构建说明可能仍然可用，但它们依赖于独立于目标项目而变化的资源。 基础镜像被停用，软件包仓库移除旧版本，工具链安装包被迁移，第三方下载链接消失（ Nourry et al., 2025 ； Mei et al., 2026 ； Malka et al., 2026 ）。 因此，即使目标源码版本没有变化，构建也可能在多年后失败。 我们将由这类变化导致的失败称为环境衰退 。 开发者通常只维护项目的当前版本，而不是恢复每一个历史版本，这项工作被留给了依赖这些历史版本的研究者和基准维护者。

paragraphs.en: Existing approaches repair build environments through reusable operations, such as Shipwright’s Dockerfile repairs ( Henkel et al., 2021 ) , or through per-case language-model agents ( Hu et al., 2025b ; Bouzenia and Pradel, 2025 ) . Per-case agents are flexible, but they repeat the diagnosis, patch generation, and validation process for every build. This is inefficient when the same environment failure affects many builds, since each case requires new model calls and one or more build executions. Moreover, external dependencies continue to change, so a restored build may fail again later. A scalable approach should therefore reuse previously validated repairs where possible, while retaining per-case reasoning for failures that cannot be handled by existing rules.
paragraphs.zh: 现有方法通过可复用操作来修复构建环境，例如 Shipwright 的 Dockerfile 修复（Henkel et al., 2021），或通过针对单个案例的语言模型智能体（Hu et al., 2025b；Bouzenia and Pradel, 2025）。 针对单个案例的智能体很灵活，但它们在每次构建时都要重复诊断、补丁生成和验证过程。 当相同的环境故障影响许多构建时，这种做法效率低下，因为每个案例都需要新的模型调用和一次或多次构建执行。 此外，外部依赖持续变化，因此修复后的构建之后可能再次失败。 因此，一种可扩展的方法应当在可能的情况下复用先前已验证的修复，同时对无法由现有规则处理的故障保留针对单个案例的推理。

paragraphs.en: In this study, we use historical OSS-Fuzz cases to examine whether reusable rules and per-case agent escalation can restore build environments efficiently at scale. These cases cover different projects, languages, dependency managers, and toolchains. Their recorded crashing inputs also let us evaluate whether a repaired environment preserves the expected historical behavior, rather than measuring build completion alone.
paragraphs.zh: 在本研究中，我们利用历史 OSS-Fuzz 案例来检验可复用规则与逐案例的智能体升级能否在大规模场景下高效恢复构建环境。 这些案例涵盖不同的项目、语言、依赖管理工具和工具链。 其记录的崩溃输入还让我们能够评估修复后的环境是否保留了预期的历史行为，而不仅仅是衡量构建是否完成。

paragraphs.en: We investigate a hybrid approach to historical build restoration. We implement Relay , a framework built around ARVO’s historical reconstruction pipeline. Relay converts build logs into normalized failure observations, groups related failures, and selects representative cases. An LLM uses evidence from these cases to propose a repair rule. The framework checks the permitted repair scope, applies the rule, and validates it by rebuilding the affected cases. Validated rules are stored in a registry and reused whenever their conditions hold. When a repair exposes a different failure, Relay records the new evidence and continues from the updated build state. Cases that remain unresolved are escalated to a per-case agent.
paragraphs.zh: 我们研究一种用于历史构建修复的混合方法。 我们实现了 Relay，一个围绕 ARVO 的历史重建流水线构建的框架。 Relay 将构建日志转换为规范化的失败观测，对相关失败进行分组，并选取代表性案例。 大语言模型利用这些案例中的证据提出修复规则。 该框架检查允许的修复范围，应用该规则，并通过重新构建受影响的案例来验证它。 经过验证的规则存储在规则库中，并在其条件成立时被重复使用。 当某次修复暴露出不同的失败时，Relay 会记录新证据，并从更新后的构建状态继续。 仍未解决的案例会被升级交给逐案例的智能体处理。

paragraphs.en: We aim to produce rules that recognize recurring failures and express repairs that can apply across cases. A rule may pin a stable version when that version addresses a recurring compatibility or availability problem, but it should not simply encode a one-off change for a single project. The model proposes both the conditions under which a rule applies and the changes it makes. For example, several builds may fail because they refer to a retired source archive. A rule should recognize the relevant download failure and redirect the request to a supported mirror or archive without reasoning about every affected case separately.
paragraphs.zh: 我们旨在产出能够识别反复出现的失败并表达可跨案例应用的修复的规则。 当某个稳定版本能够解决反复出现的兼容性或可用性问题时，规则可以固定该版本，但不应仅仅为单个项目编码一次性的变更。 模型同时提出规则适用的条件以及它所做的更改。 例如，多个构建可能因为引用了一个已退役的源码归档而失败。 规则应当识别相关的下载失败并将请求重定向到受支持的镜像或归档，而无需对每个受影响的案例分别进行推理。

paragraphs.en: Our study separates the prevalence of environment decay from the evaluation of repair. We first examine 14,159 historical OSS-Fuzz cases with recorded execution outcomes and find that 9,868 do not complete reconstruction and verification. We characterize the failures using the 4,513 cases for which we collected detailed failure logs. We then evaluate whether rules derived from representative failures transfer to other cases and whether their derivation can be automated. We compare rules, per-case agents, and their rule-first combination on the same failures. Finally, we test agent escalation on a separate set of cases where deterministic repair had stopped.
paragraphs.zh: 我们的研究将环境失效的普遍性与修复评估分离开来。 我们首先检查了 14,159 个具有记录执行结果的 OSS-Fuzz 历史案例，发现其中 9,868 个未能完成重构与验证。 我们利用收集到详细失败日志的 4,513 个案例来刻画这些失败。 我们随后评估从代表性失败中得出的规则能否迁移到其他案例，以及规则的推导能否自动化。 我们在同一批失败上比较规则、逐案例智能体，以及二者以规则优先的组合方式。 最后，我们在一组确定性修复已停滞的独立案例上测试智能体升级机制。

sents.zh: 我们随后评估从代表性失败中得出的规则能否迁移到其他案例，以及规则的推导能否自动化。

sents.en: We compare rules, per-case agents, and their rule-first combination on the same failures.
sents.zh: 我们在同一批失败上比较规则、逐案例智能体，以及二者以规则优先的组合方式。

sents.en: Finally, we test agent escalation on a separate set of cases where deterministic repair had stopped.
sents.zh: 最后，我们在一组确定性修复已停滞的独立案例上测试智能体升级机制。

paragraphs.en: RQ1: How prevalent is build decay, and how are historical build failures distributed? Reconstruction failed for 69.7% of the 14,159 cases we executed. The failures were concentrated: 161 groups contained at least five cases and represented 71.0% of the failure-analysis dataset. We found no consistent relationship between build age and repair outcome, but outcomes varied substantially across projects.
paragraphs.zh: RQ1：构建腐化的普遍程度如何，历史构建失败是如何分布的？ 在我们执行的 14,159 个案例中，69.7% 的重建失败了。 失败高度集中：161 个组至少包含五个案例，占失败分析数据集的 71.0%。 我们没有发现构建年龄与修复结果之间存在一致的关系，但结果在不同项目之间差异显著。

sents.en: RQ1: How prevalent is build decay, and how are historical build failures distributed?
sents.zh: RQ1：构建腐化的普遍程度如何，历史构建失败是如何分布的？

sents.en: Reconstruction failed for 69.7% of the 14,159 cases we executed.
sents.zh: 在我们执行的 14,159 个案例中，69.7% 的重建失败了。

sents.en: The failures were concentrated: 161 groups contained at least five cases and represented 71.0% of the failure-analysis dataset.
sents.zh: 失败高度集中：161 个组至少包含五个案例，占失败分析数据集的 71.0%。

sents.en: We found no consistent relationship between build age and repair outcome, but outcomes varied substantially across projects.
sents.zh: 我们没有发现构建年龄与修复结果之间存在一致的关系，但结果在不同项目之间差异显著。

paragraphs.en: RQ2: Can deterministic repair rules repair decayed builds, and can their derivation be automated? LLM-derived rules contributed to 469 restored builds. The automated campaign contributed 238 recoveries in two weeks, compared with 231 during three months of human-guided work.
paragraphs.zh: RQ2：确定性的修复规则能否修复衰退的构建，其推导过程能否自动化？ 由大语言模型推导出的规则助力恢复了 469 个构建。 自动化活动在两周内贡献了 238 次恢复，而人工指导的工作在三个月内仅恢复 231 次。

sents.en: RQ2: Can deterministic repair rules repair decayed builds, and can their derivation be automated?
sents.zh: RQ2：确定性的修复规则能否修复衰退的构建，其推导过程能否自动化？

sents.en: LLM-derived rules contributed to 469 restored builds.
sents.zh: 由大语言模型推导出的规则助力恢复了 469 个构建。

sents.en: The automated campaign contributed 238 recoveries in two weeks, compared with 231 during three months of human-guided work.
sents.zh: 自动化活动在两周内贡献了 238 次恢复，而人工指导的工作在三个月内仅恢复 231 次。

paragraphs.en: RQ3: How do reusable rules and per-case agents compare in recovery, cost, and the cases they restore? Rules and per-case agents restored similar numbers of builds, but the agents used 2.3 to 3.6 times as many build executions per recovery. They also restored different cases. Combining their recorded outcomes restored 37 to 39 of the 50 cases.
paragraphs.zh: RQ3：可复用规则与逐用例智能体在恢复效果、成本以及所恢复的用例方面相比如何？ 规则与逐用例智能体恢复的构建数量相近，但智能体每次恢复所使用的构建执行次数是前者的 2.3 至 3.6 倍。 它们恢复的用例也不相同。 将两者记录的结果结合起来，恢复了 50 个用例中的 37 至 39 个。

sents.en: RQ3: How do reusable rules and per-case agents compare in recovery, cost, and the cases they restore?
sents.zh: RQ3：可复用规则与逐用例智能体在恢复效果、成本以及所恢复的用例方面相比如何？

sents.en: Rules and per-case agents restored similar numbers of builds, but the agents used 2.3 to 3.6 times as many build executions per recovery.
sents.zh: 规则与逐用例智能体恢复的构建数量相近，但智能体每次恢复所使用的构建执行次数是前者的 2.3 至 3.6 倍。

sents.en: They also restored different cases.
sents.zh: 它们恢复的用例也不相同。

sents.en: Combining their recorded outcomes restored 37 to 39 of the 50 cases.
sents.zh: 将两者记录的结果结合起来，恢复了 50 个用例中的 37 至 39 个。

paragraphs.en: RQ4: Where does deterministic repair stop, and what does escalating to a per-case agent recover beyond it? Rules stopped when their edits did not fit a project’s build files or when derivation repeated variations of an unsuccessful strategy. On a subset of 57 cases that remain unresolved after rule-based repair, agents restored 17.5 to 28.1%.
paragraphs.zh: RQ4：确定性修复在哪里失效，升级为逐案例的智能体能在其之外挽回什么？ 当规则的修改无法适配项目的构建文件，或推导不断重复某种失败策略的变体时，规则就停止起作用了。 在基于规则的修复后仍未解决的 57 个案例子集上，智能体挽回了 17.5% 到 28.1%。

sents.zh: RQ4：确定性修复在哪里失效，升级为逐案例的智能体能在其之外挽回什么？

paragraphs.en: This paper makes the following contributions:
paragraphs.zh: 本文做出以下贡献：

paragraphs.en: We conduct a large-scale investigation of environment decay in 14,159 historical OSS-Fuzz cases and show that build decay is widespread and that failure causes tend to recur across unrelated cases.
paragraphs.zh: 我们对 14,159 个历史 OSS-Fuzz 案例中的环境衰变进行了大规模调查，结果表明构建衰变普遍存在，且失败原因往往在互不相关的案例中反复出现。

paragraphs.en: We present Relay , a scalable framework that derives reusable deterministic repair rules from representative failures, validates them through execution, and escalates unresolved cases to a per-case agent. It also extends historical build verification beyond C and C++.
paragraphs.zh: 我们提出 Relay，这是一个可扩展的框架，它从代表性故障中推导出可复用的确定性修复规则，通过执行来验证这些规则，并将未解决的案例升级交给逐案处理的智能体。 它还将历史构建验证的适用范围扩展到了 C 和 C++ 之外。

sents.en: We present Relay , a scalable framework that derives reusable deterministic repair rules from representative failures, validates them through execution, and escalates unresolved cases to a per-case agent.
sents.zh: 我们提出 Relay，这是一个可扩展的框架，它从代表性故障中推导出可复用的确定性修复规则，通过执行来验证这些规则，并将未解决的案例升级交给逐案处理的智能体。

sents.en: It also extends historical build verification beyond C and C++.
sents.zh: 它还将历史构建验证的适用范围扩展到了 C 和 C++ 之外。

paragraphs.en: We show that the framework can derive and validate reusable repair rules without human intervention and use them to restore historical builds.
paragraphs.zh: 我们证明该框架可以在无需人工干预的情况下推导并验证可复用的修复规则，并利用它们恢复历史构建。

paragraphs.en: We compare rule-based and per-case agentic build repair and show that a hybrid strategy combining the cost-efficiency of reusable rules with the flexibility of per-case agentic repairs is effective for large-scale build restoration.
paragraphs.zh: 我们比较了基于规则的和逐案例的智能体构建修复，并表明一种结合了可复用规则的成本效益与逐案例智能体修复的灵活性的混合策略，对于大规模构建恢复是有效的。

paragraphs.en: We provide a replication package with the rule registry, failure observations, repair records, prompts and model responses, and analysis scripts. We provide a partial version for review and will release the full package upon publication.
paragraphs.zh: 我们提供了一个可复现包，其中包含规则注册表、失败观测记录、修复记录、提示词与模型响应，以及分析脚本。 我们提供一个供评审的部分版本，并将在论文发表后发布完整包。

paragraphs.en: OSS-Fuzz is a continuous fuzzing platform that fuzzes open-source software to detect crashes and other incorrect behavior ( Serebryany, 2017 ) . When it confirms a failure, it creates a report identifying the affected project, fuzz target, sanitizer configuration, and input that triggered the failure ( Mei et al., 2026 ) . A reported failure shows that the project built and that its fuzz target executed successfully when the issue was discovered.
paragraphs.zh: OSS-Fuzz 是一个持续模糊测试平台，对开源软件进行模糊测试，以检测崩溃及其他错误行为（Serebryany, 2017）。 当它确认一个故障时，会生成一份报告，标明受影响的项目、模糊测试目标、清理器配置以及触发该故障的输入（Mei et al., 2026）。 所报告的故障表明，在发现问题当时，该项目能够构建成功，且其模糊测试目标能够顺利执行。

sents.en: OSS-Fuzz is a continuous fuzzing platform that fuzzes open-source software to detect crashes and other incorrect behavior ( Serebryany, 2017 ) .
sents.zh: OSS-Fuzz 是一个持续模糊测试平台，对开源软件进行模糊测试，以检测崩溃及其他错误行为（Serebryany, 2017）。

paragraphs.en: Projects integrated with OSS-Fuzz share a common configuration structure. Each project supplies a project.yaml file containing project metadata, a Dockerfile defining its build environment, and a build.sh script that compiles the project and its fuzz targets inside that environment ( Google, ) . This common structure provides a consistent interface for executing builds, but it does not make those builds self-contained. A Dockerfile may download base images, install system packages, or retrieve source archives, while the build script may resolve language packages, invoke code generators, and select a compiler or toolchain. These external resources can change or disappear even when the project files and target source revision remain unchanged.
paragraphs.zh: 与 OSS-Fuzz 集成的项目共享一个通用的配置结构。 每个项目都会提供一个 project.yaml 文件（包含项目元数据）、一个定义构建环境的 Dockerfile，以及一个 build.sh 脚本，用于在该环境中编译项目及其模糊测试目标 ( Google, )。 这种通用结构为执行构建提供了一致的接口，但它并不能使这些构建自包含。 Dockerfile 可能会下载基础镜像、安装系统软件包或获取源代码归档，而构建脚本可能会解析语言依赖包、调用代码生成器，并选择编译器或工具链。 即使项目文件和目标源码版本保持不变，这些外部资源也可能发生变化或消失。

paragraphs.en: Executable historical software is increasingly used to evaluate vulnerability discovery and repair systems. CyberGym evaluates vulnerability reproduction, while SEC-bench evaluates both proof-of-concept generation and vulnerability patching ( Wang et al., 2026 ; Lee et al., 2025 ) . These benchmarks require more than a source snapshot: the project must build, the relevant target must execute, and the recorded input must still exercise the expected behavior.
paragraphs.zh: 可执行的历史软件正被越来越多地用于评估漏洞发现与修复系统。 CyberGym 评估漏洞复现，而 SEC-bench 同时评估概念验证生成与漏洞修补（Wang et al., 2026；Lee et al., 2025）。 这些基准测试所要求的不只是源代码快照：项目必须能够构建，相关目标必须能够执行，且记录的输入必须仍能触发预期的行为。

paragraphs.en: ARVO reconstructs vulnerable and fixed versions of vulnerabilities reported by OSS-Fuzz ( Mei et al., 2026 ) . It combines information from the OSS-Fuzz report with historical project and dependency revisions, the OSS-Fuzz integration files, and the recorded crashing input. ARVO also addresses several recurring obstacles to historical reconstruction, including dependency revision selection, base-environment changes, and unavailable external resources. ARVO’s published dataset and evaluation focus on C and C++ memory-safety vulnerabilities. While its reconstruction approach can be extended to other ecosystems, doing so requires language-specific handling of dependencies, build outputs, and crash behavior. We extend the workflow to Rust, Go, Python, and JVM projects and add the necessary logging and validation needed to distinguish build completion from successful reproduction of the historical vulnerability. The repairs studied in this paper begin with the failures that remain after ARVO’s existing reconstruction mechanisms have run.
paragraphs.zh: ARVO 重建 OSS-Fuzz 所报告漏洞的易受攻击版本与修复版本（Mei et al., 2026）。 它将 OSS-Fuzz 报告中的信息与历史项目及依赖修订版本、OSS-Fuzz 集成文件以及记录的崩溃输入相结合。 ARVO 还解决了历史重建中的若干反复出现的障碍，包括依赖修订版本的选择、基础环境的变化以及不可用的外部资源。 ARVO 发布的数据集和评估集中在 C 和 C++ 内存安全漏洞上。 虽然其重建方法可以扩展到其他生态系统，但这样做需要针对特定语言处理依赖、构建产物和崩溃行为。 我们将这一工作流扩展到 Rust、Go、Python 和 JVM 项目，并添加了必要的日志记录与验证，以区分构建完成与成功复现历史漏洞。 本文研究的修复始于 ARVO 现有重建机制运行后仍然存在的失败。

paragraphs.en: Build failures can arise from source errors, dependency changes, unavailable resources, incompatible tools, or faults in build and container configuration. Existing repair systems often address one part of this space. For example, Shipwright groups Dockerfile failures and develops reusable repairs through a human-in-the-loop process ( Henkel et al., 2021 ) . Other approaches repair dependency-related build failures or restore language-specific environments ( Macho et al., 2018 ; Mukherjee et al., 2021 ) . More recent work includes language-model agents that configure and execute repositories individually ( Hu et al., 2025b ; Bouzenia and Pradel, 2025 ) , as well as EnvBench, a benchmark for automated environment setup ( Eliseeva et al., 2025 ) .
paragraphs.zh: 构建失败可能源于源代码错误、依赖变更、资源不可用、工具不兼容，或构建与容器配置中的缺陷。 现有的修复系统通常只解决这一空间中的某一部分。 例如，Shipwright 对 Dockerfile 失败进行分组，并通过人在回路的过程开发可复用的修复方案（Henkel et al., 2021）。 其他方法则修复与依赖相关的构建失败，或恢复特定语言的环境（Macho et al., 2018; Mukherjee et al., 2021）。 更近期的工作包括单独配置和执行代码仓库的语言模型智能体（Hu et al., 2025b; Bouzenia and Pradel, 2025），以及 EnvBench，一个面向自动化环境搭建的基准（Eliseeva et al., 2025）。

paragraphs.en: Prior work on OSS-Fuzz build failures found 25 causes of fuzzing build failures across project source, build scripts, dependencies, toolchains, external resources, and execution infrastructure ( Nourry et al., 2025 ) . These failures can occur in sequence; repairing a Docker image may expose a dependency error, and repairing that dependency may expose a compiler incompatibility. Success in progressing past one build error therefore does not establish that the complete historical build has been restored.

paragraphs.en: Relay combines the cost-efficiency of reusable rules with the flexibility of per-case agentic repair. It uses an LLM to derive deterministic rules from representative failures and applies validated rules to matching cases without further model calls. Cases that remain unresolved are escalated to a per-case agent. Both repair paths (rule and agentic) may modify files at different stages of the build, but they must preserve the historical target revision and recorded crashing input.
paragraphs.zh: Relay 将可复用规则的成本效益与逐案例智能体修复的灵活性相结合。 它使用 LLM 从代表性失败中推导出确定性规则，并将经过验证的规则应用于匹配的案例，而无需进一步的模型调用。 仍未解决的案例会被升级交由逐案例智能体处理。 两种修复路径（规则和智能体）都可能在构建的不同阶段修改文件，但它们必须保留历史目标修订版本和记录的崩溃输入。

paragraphs.en: Figure 1 shows how Relay combines deterministic repair, LLM-assisted rule derivation, and per-case agent escalation. The framework reconstructs builds, normalizes and groups failures, selects representative cases, prepares evidence, matches and applies rules, executes builds, and records outcomes. A rule-authoring LLM operates on groups of related failures and proposes deterministic rules intended for reuse. A per-case repair agent is invoked only after deterministic repair stops. It may inspect and modify one case iteratively, but remains subject to the same protected-file policy and to explicit limits on turns, builds, and tokens.

paragraphs.en: Relay uses ARVO as its execution mechanism for reconstructing a project at a specific historical revision. ARVO already controls parts of the base environment, dependency revisions, and resource retrieval, and attempts its own environment fixes during reconstruction ( Mei et al., 2026 ) . Our repair loop therefore begins with the failures that remain after those mechanisms have run. It surrounds ARVO with evidence collection, reusable rule derivation and application, repair state management, and agent escalation. Relay does not replace ARVO’s reconstruction workflow but rather invokes that workflow repeatedly to observe and validate environment repairs.
paragraphs.zh: Relay 使用 ARVO 作为其执行机制，用于在特定历史版本处重建项目。 ARVO 已经控制了基础环境、依赖版本和资源检索的部分内容，并在重建过程中尝试自行进行环境修复（Mei et al., 2026）。 因此，我们的修复循环从这些机制运行后仍然存在的故障开始。 它在 ARVO 之上包围了证据收集、可复用规则的推导与应用、修复状态管理以及智能体升级。 Relay 并不替代 ARVO 的重建工作流，而是反复调用该工作流以观察和验证环境修复。

paragraphs.en: The original ARVO workflow used as our starting point selects C/C++ cases. We extend selection and verification to non-C/C++ projects, including language-aware handling of Rust, Python, and JVM crash signals and target wrappers. The Dockerfile/build-script interface made much of the existing build machinery reusable across ecosystems, while crash verification required separate handling. We also add an interface for applying repair rules and record which repairs were attempted, whether they were applied, and how each execution ended. These records let us distinguish project build failures, repairs that could not be applied, and failures in the execution infrastructure.
paragraphs.zh: 作为我们起点的原始 ARVO 工作流选择的是 C/C++ 案例。 我们将选择与验证扩展到非 C/C++ 项目，包括对 Rust、Python 和 JVM 崩溃信号及目标包装器的语言感知处理。 Dockerfile/构建脚本接口使许多现有的构建机制可以跨生态系统复用，而崩溃验证则需要单独处理。 我们还增加了一个应用修复规则的接口，并记录尝试了哪些修复、是否被应用，以及每次执行的结果。 这些记录让我们能够区分项目构建失败、无法应用的修复，以及执行基础设施中的故障。

paragraphs.en: To reduce the risk of modifying program behavior, we permit repairs only to the build environment: Dockerfiles, build scripts, package-manager configuration, dependency metadata, resource locations, and toolchain setup. The target source revision, program source, crashing input, fuzz target, and sanitizer configuration are protected. An attempted change to a protected input, whether produced by a rule or a repair agent, is rejected before execution.
paragraphs.zh: 为降低修改程序行为的风险，我们只允许对构建环境进行修复：Dockerfile、构建脚本、包管理器配置、依赖元数据、资源位置以及工具链设置。 目标源码版本、程序源码、崩溃输入、模糊测试目标以及净化器配置均受到保护。 对受保护输入的任何修改尝试，无论是规则产生的还是智能体产生的，都会在执行前被拒绝。

sents.en: To reduce the risk of modifying program behavior, we permit repairs only to the build environment: Dockerfiles, build scripts, package-manager configuration, dependency metadata, resource locations, and toolchain setup.
sents.zh: 为降低修改程序行为的风险，我们只允许对构建环境进行修复：Dockerfile、构建脚本、包管理器配置、依赖元数据、资源位置以及工具链设置。

sents.zh: 目标源码版本、程序源码、崩溃输入、模糊测试目标以及净化器配置均受到保护。

paragraphs.en: Each execution produces a run directory containing output streams, status records, available log metadata, and a normalized case observation. Relay classifies the failure, estimates the execution phase reached at which it occurred, and derives a signature from the relevant log excerpt. Relay selects excerpts using generic and ecosystem-specific failure markers and the evidence requirements of existing rules. It then normalizes dynamic content such as paths, identifiers, hashes, version numbers, line numbers, and repeated whitespace. The grouping key combines failure class, phase, and signature hash. Including the phase prevents a similar message during image creation and target execution from being treated as the same blocker.
paragraphs.zh: 每次执行都会生成一个运行目录，其中包含输出流、状态记录、可用的日志元数据，以及一个规范化的用例观测结果。 Relay 会对失败进行分类，估计失败发生时所处的执行阶段，并根据相关日志摘录推导出一个签名。 Relay 使用通用的和针对特定生态系统的失败标记，以及现有规则的证据要求来选择日志摘录。 然后，它会对动态内容进行规范化，例如路径、标识符、哈希值、版本号、行号和重复的空白字符。 分组键由失败类别、阶段和签名哈希组合而成。 包含阶段这一项，是为了防止在镜像构建和目标执行期间出现的类似消息被当作同一个阻塞问题。

paragraphs.en: Relay groups similar failures to select cases for rule derivation, but the same error message can have different causes. For example, removing version numbers during normalization can group failures involving different dependency versions. We therefore keep the original logs for rule derivation and test each rule by rebuilding every case to which it is applied.
paragraphs.zh: Relay 将相似的失败归为一组以选择用于规则推导的案例，但相同的错误信息可能有不同的原因。 例如，在归一化过程中去除版本号，可能把涉及不同依赖版本的失败归为一组。 因此，我们保留原始日志用于规则推导，并通过重新构建应用该规则的每个案例来测试每条规则。

paragraphs.en: Relay then organizes observations in a tree from coarse categories to exact signatures: failure class, phase, cluster family, ecosystem, error pattern, abstract template, and normalized signature. This hierarchy lets the framework prioritize high-yield branches, where one reusable repair may affect many builds, as well as branches that have not yet been examined. We refer to a case selected from a branch for rule authoring and initial validation as a representative . Representatives provide concrete evidence for the branch, but do not eliminate the need to validate other matching cases.
paragraphs.zh: 随后，Relay 将观察结果组织成一棵树，从粗粒度类别到精确签名依次为：失败类别、阶段、集群家族、生态系统、错误模式、抽象模板和归一化签名。 这种层次结构使框架能够优先处理高产出分支（即一个可复用修复可能影响许多构建的分支），以及尚未被检查过的分支。 我们将从一个分支中选出用于规则编写和初始验证的案例称为代表案例。 代表案例为分支提供了具体证据，但并不能免除对其他匹配案例进行验证的需要。

paragraphs.en: Rather than provide complete logs to the rule-authoring model, Relay constructs bounded evidence packets. A packet contains relevant excerpts, the failure class, phase and signature, case metadata, and repair history. The history records previously applied rules and how the observed failure changed after each rebuild. Excerpt selection uses generic and ecosystem-specific failure markers, the evidence requirements of existing rules, and removes repeated or redundant log content. Relay records packet sizes and token counts to bound the cost of each proposal, with the trade-off that a packet may omit useful context. When the available evidence is insufficient, the framework schedules a fresh execution or a targeted diagnostic execution and constructs a new packet before requesting another proposal.
paragraphs.zh: Relay 不向规则编写模型提供完整的日志，而是构建有界的证据包。 每个证据包包含相关的日志摘录、失败类别、阶段与签名、案例元数据以及修复历史。 修复历史记录了先前已应用的规则，以及每次重建后所观察到的失败如何变化。 摘录的选取使用通用型和生态系统特定的失败标记，并参考现有规则的证据要求，同时去除重复或冗余的日志内容。 Relay 记录证据包的大小与 token 数量，以约束每次提议的成本，其代价是证据包可能遗漏有用的上下文。 当可用证据不足时，该框架会调度一次全新的执行或一次针对性的诊断执行，并在请求下一次提议之前构建新的证据包。

paragraphs.en: Before requesting a new rule, Relay checks the current observation against the validated rules in its registry. If a rule matches, the framework applies it without invoking a model. Rule derivation begins only when the registry contains no eligible rule for the observed failure.
paragraphs.zh: 在请求新规则之前，Relay 会将当前观察结果与其注册表中已验证的规则进行比对。 如果某条规则匹配成功，该框架会直接应用它，而无需调用模型。 只有当注册表中不存在适用于所观察到的故障的可用规则时，才会开始规则推导。

sents.zh: 在请求新规则之前，Relay 会将当前观察结果与其注册表中已验证的规则进行比对。

paragraphs.en: For a selected branch, the rule-authoring LLM receives evidence packets from its representatives, relevant repair history, and descriptions of existing rules. It returns a structured candidate containing a failure precondition, parameters to extract from the evidence, permitted repair operations, evidence requirements, and allowed file scope. We instruct the model to express repairs in terms of the observed failure rather than project names, case identifiers, or constants copied from one case. For example, Figure 2 shows a toolchain rule that reads the name of the missing Rust toolchain from the failing path and installs it, instead of hard-coding one toolchain. A version may be pinned when the evidence establishes a compatibility requirement, but the rule must also state when that pin applies.
paragraphs.zh: 对于选定的分支，规则撰写 LLM 会接收来自其代表的证据包、相关修复历史以及现有规则的描述。 它返回一个结构化的候选规则，其中包含失败前提条件、需从证据中提取的参数、允许的修复操作、证据要求以及允许的文件范围。 我们指示模型依据所观察到的失败来表达修复，而不是使用项目名称、用例标识符或从单个用例复制来的常量。 例如，图 2 展示了一条工具链规则，它从失败的路径中读取缺失的 Rust 工具链名称并进行安装，而不是硬编码某个工具链。 当证据确立了兼容性要求时，可以固定版本，但规则还必须说明该固定在何时适用。

paragraphs.en: In the human-guided campaign, one of the authors selected branches, reviewed the evidence, and guided or revised model proposals. In the fully automated campaign, the framework selected branches, constructed prompts, invoked the model, materialized its proposal, and scheduled validation without human intervention. In both settings, the model proposed a repair, but execution determined whether it worked.
paragraphs.zh: 在人类引导的活动中，作者之一负责选择分支、审查证据，并引导或修订智能体的提案。 在全自动活动中，该框架自主选择分支、构造提示词、调用模型、落实其提案，并安排验证，全程无需人工干预。 在两种设置中，模型都会提出修复方案，但最终是否有效取决于执行结果。

sents.en: In the human-guided campaign, one of the authors selected branches, reviewed the evidence, and guided or revised model proposals.
sents.zh: 在人类引导的活动中，作者之一负责选择分支、审查证据，并引导或修订智能体的提案。

sents.en: In the fully automated campaign, the framework selected branches, constructed prompts, invoked the model, materialized its proposal, and scheduled validation without human intervention.
sents.zh: 在全自动活动中，该框架自主选择分支、构造提示词、调用模型、落实其提案，并安排验证，全程无需人工干预。

sents.zh: 在两种设置中，模型都会提出修复方案，但最终是否有效取决于执行结果。

paragraphs.en: A proposal is not immediately added to the rule registry. The framework checks its scope, applies its operations against the historical build files, and rebuilds representative cases. Before adding a proposal to the registry, the framework checks its scope, applies its operations to the historical build files, and rebuilds representative cases. It accepts the rule only if the execution restores a build or exposes a different failure. Once a rule is adopted, later applications require no further model calls.
paragraphs.zh: 提案不会立即被加入规则注册表。 框架会检查其范围，将其操作应用于历史构建文件，并重新构建代表性案例。 在将提案加入注册表之前，框架会检查其范围，将其操作应用于历史构建文件，并重新构建代表性案例。 只有当执行恢复了构建或暴露出不同的失败时，框架才会接受该规则。 一旦规则被采纳，后续应用无需再调用模型。

sents.en: A proposal is not immediately added to the rule registry.
sents.zh: 提案不会立即被加入规则注册表。

sents.en: The framework checks its scope, applies its operations against the historical build files, and rebuilds representative cases.
sents.zh: 框架会检查其范围，将其操作应用于历史构建文件，并重新构建代表性案例。

sents.en: Before adding a proposal to the registry, the framework checks its scope, applies its operations to the historical build files, and rebuilds representative cases.
sents.zh: 在将提案加入注册表之前，框架会检查其范围，将其操作应用于历史构建文件，并重新构建代表性案例。

sents.zh: 只有当执行恢复了构建或暴露出不同的失败时，框架才会接受该规则。

sents.zh: 一旦规则被采纳，后续应用无需再调用模型。

paragraphs.en: A rule pairs a failure precondition with a repair specification. Preconditions describe the observation and relevant context. Repair specifications use bounded operations such as rewriting a URL, pinning a dependency, installing a package, selecting a toolchain, replacing a base image, or editing a build script. The rule applicator applies these operations against the historical build files.
paragraphs.zh: 规则将失败前提条件与修复规范配对。 前提条件描述观察结果和相关上下文。 修复规范使用有界的操作，例如重写 URL、固定依赖项、安装软件包、选择工具链、替换基础镜像或编辑构建脚本。 规则应用器针对历史构建文件执行这些操作。

sents.en: A rule pairs a failure precondition with a repair specification.
sents.zh: 规则将失败前提条件与修复规范配对。

sents.en: Preconditions describe the observation and relevant context.
sents.zh: 前提条件描述观察结果和相关上下文。

sents.en: Repair specifications use bounded operations such as rewriting a URL, pinning a dependency, installing a package, selecting a toolchain, replacing a base image, or editing a build script.
sents.zh: 修复规范使用有界的操作，例如重写 URL、固定依赖项、安装软件包、选择工具链、替换基础镜像或编辑构建脚本。

sents.en: The rule applicator applies these operations against the historical build files.
sents.zh: 规则应用器针对历史构建文件执行这些操作。

paragraphs.en: Three decisions remain separate. First, the matcher determines whether the current observation satisfies a rule’s preconditions. Second, the applicator determines whether the requested operations can be carried out on the available files without violating the repair scope. Third, a new ARVO execution determines whether the applied repair recovers the build, exposes a different failure, or leaves the original failure unchanged. We record all three outcomes so that a matching error, an application failure, and an ineffective repair are not treated as the same event.
paragraphs.zh: 三项决策仍保持独立。 首先，匹配器（matcher）判断当前观察是否满足某条规则的前置条件。 其次，应用器（applicator）判断在不违反修复范围的前提下，能否对可用文件执行所请求的操作。 再次，一次新的 ARVO 执行判断所应用的修复是恢复了构建，还是暴露了不同的失败，或是使原有失败保持不变。 我们记录这三种结果，以便匹配错误、应用失败与无效修复不会被当作同一事件处理。

sents.en: Three decisions remain separate.
sents.zh: 三项决策仍保持独立。

sents.en: First, the matcher determines whether the current observation satisfies a rule’s preconditions.
sents.zh: 首先，匹配器（matcher）判断当前观察是否满足某条规则的前置条件。

sents.en: Second, the applicator determines whether the requested operations can be carried out on the available files without violating the repair scope.
sents.zh: 其次，应用器（applicator）判断在不违反修复范围的前提下，能否对可用文件执行所请求的操作。

sents.en: Third, a new ARVO execution determines whether the applied repair recovers the build, exposes a different failure, or leaves the original failure unchanged.
sents.zh: 再次，一次新的 ARVO 执行判断所应用的修复是恢复了构建，还是暴露了不同的失败，或是使原有失败保持不变。

sents.en: We record all three outcomes so that a matching error, an application failure, and an ineffective repair are not treated as the same event.
sents.zh: 我们记录这三种结果，以便匹配错误、应用失败与无效修复不会被当作同一事件处理。

paragraphs.en: Each rule targets a specific breakage step : an identifiable operation that fails during reconstruction, such as retrieving a retired archive, installing a missing package, or invoking an incompatible toolchain. The same rule can repair a failure across several versions or projects if it recognizes the failure and can apply the required change to their build files.
paragraphs.zh: 每条规则针对一个特定的损坏步骤：即在重建过程中失败的可识别操作，例如获取已停用的归档文件、安装缺失的软件包，或调用不兼容的工具链。 如果同一条规则能够识别故障并对这些项目的构建文件应用所需的更改，它就可以跨多个版本或项目修复故障。

sents.en: Each rule targets a specific breakage step : an identifiable operation that fails during reconstruction, such as retrieving a retired archive, installing a missing package, or invoking an incompatible toolchain.
sents.zh: 每条规则针对一个特定的损坏步骤：即在重建过程中失败的可识别操作，例如获取已停用的归档文件、安装缺失的软件包，或调用不兼容的工具链。

sents.en: The same rule can repair a failure across several versions or projects if it recognizes the failure and can apply the required change to their build files.
sents.zh: 如果同一条规则能够识别故障并对这些项目的构建文件应用所需的更改，它就可以跨多个版本或项目修复故障。

paragraphs.en: A build may fail again after its first error is fixed. For example, an unavailable base image prevents compilation from starting, while a failed source download can hide a later dependency error. Relay therefore keeps edits that resolve an intermediate failure and rebuilds after each applied rule. These edits form a repair chain. After each rebuild, Relay uses the latest failure to select the next rule. Cases that initially failed for different reasons may then encounter the same failure and reuse the same rule.
paragraphs.zh: 构建在修复第一个错误后可能再次失败。 例如，基础镜像不可用会阻止编译启动，而源码下载失败可能掩盖后续的依赖错误。 因此，Relay 会保留解决中间失败的修改，并在每次应用规则后重新构建。 这些修改构成一条修复链。 每次重新构建后，Relay 使用最新的失败来选择下一条规则。 最初因不同原因失败的用例随后可能遇到相同的失败并复用同一规则。

sents.en: A build may fail again after its first error is fixed.
sents.zh: 构建在修复第一个错误后可能再次失败。

sents.en: For example, an unavailable base image prevents compilation from starting, while a failed source download can hide a later dependency error.
sents.zh: 例如，基础镜像不可用会阻止编译启动，而源码下载失败可能掩盖后续的依赖错误。

sents.en: Relay therefore keeps edits that resolve an intermediate failure and rebuilds after each applied rule.
sents.zh: 因此，Relay 会保留解决中间失败的修改，并在每次应用规则后重新构建。

sents.en: These edits form a repair chain.
sents.zh: 这些修改构成一条修复链。

sents.en: After each rebuild, Relay uses the latest failure to select the next rule.
sents.zh: 每次重新构建后，Relay 使用最新的失败来选择下一条规则。

sents.en: Cases that initially failed for different reasons may then encounter the same failure and reuse the same rule.
sents.zh: 最初因不同原因失败的用例随后可能遇到相同的失败并复用同一规则。

paragraphs.en: Relay determines whether a repair restored the build or exposed a different failure by rebuilding the case. It records a change in failure class or signature as a progression , rather than a recovery. When this happens, the framework keeps the repair chain and continues from the newly observed failure.
paragraphs.zh: Relay 通过重新构建用例来判断修复是恢复了构建，还是暴露了另一个失败。 它将失败类别或签名的变化记录为一种演进，而不是一次恢复。 当这种情况发生时，该框架会保留修复链，并从新观察到的失败继续进行。

sents.en: Relay determines whether a repair restored the build or exposed a different failure by rebuilding the case.
sents.zh: Relay 通过重新构建用例来判断修复是恢复了构建，还是暴露了另一个失败。

sents.en: It records a change in failure class or signature as a progression , rather than a recovery.
sents.zh: 它将失败类别或签名的变化记录为一种演进，而不是一次恢复。

sents.en: When this happens, the framework keeps the repair chain and continues from the newly observed failure.
sents.zh: 当这种情况发生时，该框架会保留修复链，并从新观察到的失败继续进行。

paragraphs.en: Relay stops deterministic repair when the build recovers, no eligible rule remains, two consecutive attempts return the same failure state, or the required action exceeds the permitted scope. It records why it stopped, including whether a case needs a new rule, an unavailable resource, case-specific reasoning, or an edit that the applicator could not apply. It records infrastructure failures and provenance problems separately from repair outcomes.
paragraphs.zh: 当构建恢复、不再有符合条件的规则、连续两次尝试返回相同的失败状态、或所需操作超出允许范围时，Relay 停止确定性修复。 它记录停止的原因，包括是否需要为新情况添加新规则、是否存在不可用的资源、是否需要针对特定情况的推理，或者是否存在无法应用的编辑。 它将基础设施故障和溯源问题与修复结果分开记录。

sents.en: Relay stops deterministic repair when the build recovers, no eligible rule remains, two consecutive attempts return the same failure state, or the required action exceeds the permitted scope.
sents.zh: 当构建恢复、不再有符合条件的规则、连续两次尝试返回相同的失败状态、或所需操作超出允许范围时，Relay 停止确定性修复。

sents.en: It records why it stopped, including whether a case needs a new rule, an unavailable resource, case-specific reasoning, or an edit that the applicator could not apply.
sents.zh: 它记录停止的原因，包括是否需要为新情况添加新规则、是否存在不可用的资源、是否需要针对特定情况的推理，或者是否存在无法应用的编辑。

sents.en: It records infrastructure failures and provenance problems separately from repair outcomes.
sents.zh: 它将基础设施故障和溯源问题与修复结果分开记录。

paragraphs.en: Relay escalates cases with a repairable build failure when no applicable rule remains. It defers cases blocked by infrastructure failures or a confirmed unavailable resource. The agent receives the case’s current failure, complete repair history, and build files. It can inspect logs and files, probe the environment, make edits, and invoke ARVO. It keeps earlier edits as it works on subsequent failures.
paragraphs.zh: 当没有适用的规则剩余时，Relay 会将存在可修复构建失败的案例升级处理。 对于被基础设施故障或确认不可用的资源所阻塞的案例，它会推迟处理。 智能体会接收该案例当前的失败情况、完整的修复历史以及构建文件。 它可以检查日志和文件、探测环境、进行编辑，并调用 ARVO。 在处理后续失败时，它会保留之前的编辑。

sents.en: Relay escalates cases with a repairable build failure when no applicable rule remains.
sents.zh: 当没有适用的规则剩余时，Relay 会将存在可修复构建失败的案例升级处理。

sents.en: It defers cases blocked by infrastructure failures or a confirmed unavailable resource.
sents.zh: 对于被基础设施故障或确认不可用的资源所阻塞的案例，它会推迟处理。

sents.en: The agent receives the case’s current failure, complete repair history, and build files.
sents.zh: 智能体会接收该案例当前的失败情况、完整的修复历史以及构建文件。

sents.en: It can inspect logs and files, probe the environment, make edits, and invoke ARVO.
sents.zh: 它可以检查日志和文件、探测环境、进行编辑，并调用 ARVO。

sents.en: It keeps earlier edits as it works on subsequent failures.
sents.zh: 在处理后续失败时，它会保留之前的编辑。

paragraphs.en: The agent aims to repair one case. Its patch does not need to generalize, and Relay does not automatically add it to the rule registry. The agent can make case-specific edits that the deterministic rule operations cannot express, but it cannot change the protected source revision, program source, fuzz target, crashing input, or sanitizer configuration. Relay limits the model turns, build executions, and tokens available for each case and counts a recovery only when a new execution confirms that the build has been restored.
paragraphs.zh: 智能体的目标是修复单个案例。 其补丁不需要具备通用性，Relay 也不会自动将其添加到规则注册表中。 智能体可以进行确定性规则操作无法表达的针对特定案例的修改，但它不能更改受保护的源码修订版本、程序源码、模糊测试目标、崩溃输入或消毒器配置。 Relay 限制了每个案例可用的模型轮次、构建执行次数和 token 数量，并且只有当新的执行确认构建已恢复时，才计为一次恢复。

sents.en: The agent aims to repair one case.
sents.zh: 智能体的目标是修复单个案例。

sents.en: Its patch does not need to generalize, and Relay does not automatically add it to the rule registry.
sents.zh: 其补丁不需要具备通用性，Relay 也不会自动将其添加到规则注册表中。

sents.en: The agent can make case-specific edits that the deterministic rule operations cannot express, but it cannot change the protected source revision, program source, fuzz target, crashing input, or sanitizer configuration.

sents.en: Relay limits the model turns, build executions, and tokens available for each case and counts a recovery only when a new execution confirms that the build has been restored.
sents.zh: Relay 限制了每个案例可用的模型轮次、构建执行次数和 token 数量，并且只有当新的执行确认构建已恢复时，才计为一次恢复。

paragraphs.en: We answer four research questions using different subsets of the OSS-Fuzz cases described below. RQ1 measures the prevalence and distribution of historical reconstruction failures. RQ2 evaluates reusable repair rules and whether their derivation can be automated. RQ3 compares reusable rules, per-case agents, and their rule-first combination on the same failures. RQ4 examines why deterministic repair stops and what per-case agents recover after it does.
paragraphs.zh: 我们使用下述 OSS-Fuzz 案例的不同子集来回答四个研究问题。 RQ1 衡量历史重构失败的普遍程度与分布情况。 RQ2 评估可复用的修复规则，以及其推导过程能否自动化。 RQ3 在相同的失败案例上比较可复用规则、逐案例智能体，以及两者的规则优先组合方法。 RQ4 考察确定性修复为何停止，以及停止之后逐案例智能体能恢复什么。

sents.en: We answer four research questions using different subsets of the OSS-Fuzz cases described below.
sents.zh: 我们使用下述 OSS-Fuzz 案例的不同子集来回答四个研究问题。

sents.en: RQ1 measures the prevalence and distribution of historical reconstruction failures.
sents.zh: RQ1 衡量历史重构失败的普遍程度与分布情况。

sents.en: RQ2 evaluates reusable repair rules and whether their derivation can be automated.
sents.zh: RQ2 评估可复用的修复规则，以及其推导过程能否自动化。

sents.en: RQ3 compares reusable rules, per-case agents, and their rule-first combination on the same failures.
sents.zh: RQ3 在相同的失败案例上比较可复用规则、逐案例智能体，以及两者的规则优先组合方法。

sents.en: RQ4 examines why deterministic repair stops and what per-case agents recover after it does.
sents.zh: RQ4 考察确定性修复为何停止，以及停止之后逐案例智能体能恢复什么。

paragraphs.en: We constructed the dataset from an OSS-Fuzz issue-tracker snapshot collected on January 27, 2026. Each eligible issue contributes at most one case containing the project, fuzz target, crashing input, sanitizer, and historical source revisions required by ARVO. Issues without sufficient reconstruction metadata are excluded.
paragraphs.zh: 我们基于2026年1月27日收集的OSS-Fuzz问题追踪器快照构建了该数据集。 每个符合条件的问题最多贡献一个案例，其中包含ARVO所需的项目、模糊测试目标、崩溃输入、消毒器和历史源码版本。 缺乏足够重建元数据的问题将被排除。

sents.zh: 我们基于2026年1月27日收集的OSS-Fuzz问题追踪器快照构建了该数据集。

paragraphs.en: Historical reconstruction is computationally expensive: each execution attempts to restore the build environment, build the relevant project revisions, and run the recorded crashing input. Across the cases in our dataset, the recorded execution times total approximately 1,894 hours, and 174 cases took at least one hour. We therefore evaluated a broad subset of the collected issues rather than attempting every issue in the tracker.
paragraphs.zh: 历史重建的计算开销很高：每次执行都需要尝试恢复构建环境、构建相关的项目修订版本，并运行所记录的崩溃输入。 在我们数据集中的各案例中，所记录的执行时间总计约为1,894小时，其中174个案例的执行时间至少为一小时。 因此，我们评估了所收集问题的一个较广子集，而不是尝试追踪器中的每一个问题。

paragraphs.en: Our pipeline first invokes ARVO’s existing reconstruction mechanisms, including its handling of historical dependencies, base environments, and unavailable resources. The failures studied here are therefore cases that remain unresolved after this initial reconstruction. Of the 14,159 cases in the dataset, 9,868 did not complete reconstruction and verification, giving a failure rate of 69.7%. ARVO’s published reproduction rate ( Mei et al., 2026 ) and the failure rate reported in this paper come from different case selections and execution periods and should not be compared directly.

paragraphs.en: The first four rows show how we narrowed the dataset from all executed cases to those attempted during the repair campaigns. We use all 14,159 executed cases to measure the prevalence of build failures. We then collected detailed execution logs for 4,513 cases and assembled them into a failure-analysis dataset to classify and group failures. Out of these, we attempted to repair 2,451 cases during the repair campaigns. We use three separately selected groups for the controlled evaluations. We held out 400 previously unattempted cases to test whether our rule registry could repair failures beyond the cases explored during the campaign. We also selected 50 previously repaired cases that still fail on re-execution to compare reusable rules with per-case agents on the same inputs. Lastly, we selected 60 cases recorded as unresolved after deterministic repair. Before running the agents, we rebuilt each case without a repair to verify that they were still failing and found that 3 cases built successfully. Their outcomes had therefore changed between the time we sampled them and the time we evaluated them which can occur for various reasons such as external dependencies not being fully pinned. We excluded them because they no longer presented a build failure and used the remaining 57 cases to test what per-case agents recover after rule-based repair stops.

paragraphs.en: Relay does not try to repair every case separately. It groups similar failures and selects representatives from promising groups. It then derives and validates rules on those representatives. A case is executed when it is chosen as a representative or when an accepted rule matches its failure. This gives priority to recurring failures for which one rule may repair several cases.
paragraphs.zh: Relay 不会试图对每个案例分别进行修复。 它将相似的失败分组，并从有前景的组中选出代表案例。 然后在这些代表案例上推导并验证规则。 当一个案例被选为代表案例，或某条已接受的规则与其失败匹配时，该案例就会被执行。 这使反复出现的失败获得优先处理，因为一条规则可能修复多个案例。

sents.zh: Relay 不会试图对每个案例分别进行修复。

sents.en: It groups similar failures and selects representatives from promising groups.
sents.zh: 它将相似的失败分组，并从有前景的组中选出代表案例。

sents.en: It then derives and validates rules on those representatives.
sents.zh: 然后在这些代表案例上推导并验证规则。

paragraphs.en: Across the RQ1 and RQ2 campaigns, Relay attempted to repair 2,451 distinct cases. It rebuilt each case after applying a repair, sometimes exposing another failure that required a further change. Relay stopped deterministic repair when the build recovered or when two consecutive repair attempts returned the same failure state without exposing a new one. We set limits on build executions, model turns, tokens, and cost for agent runs, as summarized in Table 2 . Note that an unresolved case may still be repairable with a larger budget.
paragraphs.zh: 在 RQ1 和 RQ2 的实验中，Relay 尝试修复了 2,451 个不同的案例。 它在应用一次修复后会重新构建每个案例，有时会暴露出另一个需要进一步修改的失败。 当构建恢复成功，或连续两次修复尝试返回相同的失败状态而没有暴露新失败时，Relay 会停止确定性修复。 我们为智能体运行设置了构建执行次数、模型轮次、token 数量和成本的上限，如表 2 所总结。 请注意，未解决的案例在更大的预算下仍然可能是可修复的。

paragraphs.en: All models use the same agent harness. Each agent receives the case evidence, complete build logs, and historical build files. It can inspect files, run read-only shell commands, edit the permitted build-environment files, and rebuild the case. The harness disables web access, and prevents changes to the protected source revision, program source, fuzz target, crashing input, and sanitizer configuration. After each rebuild, the agent receives the latest failure and can address the newly exposed blocker without discarding earlier changes. If the harness cannot apply a patch, it returns the error to the agent so that it can propose a correction.
paragraphs.zh: 所有模型都使用相同的智能体框架。 每个智能体接收案例证据、完整的构建日志以及历史构建文件。 它可以检查文件、运行只读 shell 命令、编辑允许修改的构建环境文件，并重新构建案例。 该框架禁用网络访问，并阻止对受保护的源码修订版本、程序源码、模糊测试目标、崩溃输入以及清理器配置的更改。 每次重新构建后，智能体会收到最新的失败信息，可以在不丢弃先前修改的情况下解决新暴露的阻碍问题。 如果框架无法应用补丁，它会把错误返回给智能体，以便其提出修正方案。

paragraphs.en: Our primary outcome is build recovery (i.e., the build completes successfully). We also check whether the repaired environment preserves the historical crash behavior. We count the vulnerability as reproduced when the recorded input triggers a crash at the vulnerable revision. We classify a case as benchmark-ready when the input triggers the crash at the vulnerable revision and runs without a crash at the designated fixed revision.

paragraphs.en: We measure repair effort through build executions. For each approach, we divide the total number of build executions across all evaluated cases by the number of recovered cases. This includes executions spent on cases that remain unresolved. Proposed edits that the harness cannot apply do not launch a build and do not contribute to this count. For agent runs, we also report model calls, token use, and hosted-model charges.
paragraphs.zh: 我们通过构建执行次数来衡量修复开销。 对于每种方法，我们将所有被评估用例的构建执行总次数除以成功恢复的用例数。 其中包括花费在仍未解决用例上的执行次数。 智能体框架无法应用的建议编辑不会启动构建，也不计入该统计。 对于智能体运行，我们还报告模型调用次数、令牌使用量和托管模型费用。

paragraphs.en: We inspect execution errors before classifying outcomes. We count patches that fail to apply, attempts to edit protected files, and decisions by the model to stop as agent outcomes. We report results for all selected cases. For each paired comparison, we also report results after excluding cases where either approach encountered a harness failure that prevented a reliable outcome.

paragraphs.en: Before developing a repair framework, we first need to establish whether historical build failures are common and whether the same failures affect multiple cases. Reusable rules are useful only when failures repeat. RQ1 therefore measures how often historical reconstruction fails, how strongly the failures are concentrated, and whether repair outcomes vary by age or project.
paragraphs.zh: 在开发修复框架之前，我们首先需要确认历史上的构建失败是否常见，以及相同的失败是否会影响多个案例。 可复用的规则只有在失败重复出现时才有用。 因此，RQ1 衡量历史重建失败的频率、失败的集中程度，以及修复结果是否因项目年龄或项目本身而异。

sents.en: Before developing a repair framework, we first need to establish whether historical build failures are common and whether the same failures affect multiple cases.
sents.zh: 在开发修复框架之前，我们首先需要确认历史上的构建失败是否常见，以及相同的失败是否会影响多个案例。

sents.zh: 因此，RQ1 衡量历史重建失败的频率、失败的集中程度，以及修复结果是否因项目年龄或项目本身而异。

paragraphs.en: We calculated the overall failure rate across the 14,159 cases we executed. We used the 4,513 cases in the failure-analysis dataset to examine how often the same failure occurred across multiple cases.
paragraphs.zh: 我们计算了所执行的 14,159 个案例的总体失败率。 我们使用失败分析数据集中的 4,513 个案例，考察同一失败在多个案例中出现的频率。

sents.en: We calculated the overall failure rate across the 14,159 cases we executed.
sents.zh: 我们计算了所执行的 14,159 个案例的总体失败率。

sents.zh: 我们使用失败分析数据集中的 4,513 个案例，考察同一失败在多个案例中出现的频率。

paragraphs.en: We assigned each case to the first failure observed before any repair was attempted. As described in Section 3 , we represented each failure by its class, execution phase, and normalized signature. Cases sharing all three values formed a baseline failure group. We report the number and size of these groups, along with the share of cases in groups of at least five and the share that occurred alone. We chose five as the threshold because it left enough cases to inspect representatives and test whether a repair transferred to other cases. We kept this initial grouping fixed throughout the analysis. Failures exposed by later repair attempts did not change a case’s baseline group.
paragraphs.zh: 在尝试任何修复之前，我们将每个案例归入最先观察到的失败。 如第 3 节所述，我们用类别、执行阶段和规范化签名来表示每个失败。 三个值都相同的案例构成了一个基线失败组。 我们报告这些组的数量和规模，以及至少包含五个案例的组中案例所占的比例，以及单独出现的案例所占的比例。 我们选择五作为阈值，因为它留下了足够的案例来检查代表性案例，并测试某项修复是否能迁移到其他案例。 在整个分析过程中，我们保持这一初始分组固定不变。 后续修复尝试所暴露的失败不会改变某个案例的基线组。

paragraphs.en: We also measured how often a failed case later built without a repair. Among the 2,451 cases included in the repair campaigns, we classified a case as a no-patch recovery when a later execution succeeded without a repair chain. This showed that re-execution was sufficient, but not why the initial execution failed. For the age and project analyses, we used outcomes from the deterministic repair campaigns evaluated in RQ2. We classified a case as recovered if any campaign execution succeeded, with or without a repair. Of the 1,320 attempted cases with a known vulnerable revision date, we included those from projects with at least ten such cases spanning at least two historical years. These criteria left 884 cases from 23 projects and gave each half of the within-project comparison at least five cases. Within each project, we ordered cases by their vulnerable revision date and split them at the median. We then compared the unresolved rates of the older and newer halves. We used an exact two-sided sign test, excluding ties, to determine whether the differences consistently pointed in either direction. Finally, we report project-level unresolved rates only for projects with at least twenty attempted cases to avoid comparisons based on only a few cases.
paragraphs.zh: 我们还测量了失败案例随后在未经修复的情况下构建成功的频率。 在纳入修复活动的 2,451 个案例中，当某案例后续执行在没有修复链的情况下成功时，我们将其归类为无补丁恢复。 这表明重新执行就足够了，但无法解释初始执行为何失败。 对于时间跨度与项目分析，我们使用了在 RQ2 中评估的确定性修复活动的结果。 只要某案例在任一次活动执行中成功，无论有无修复，我们都将其归类为已恢复。 在 1,320 个已知漏洞修订日期的尝试案例中，我们纳入了来自拥有至少十个此类案例且跨越至少两个历史年份的项目的案例。 这些标准留下了来自 23 个项目的 884 个案例，并使每个项目内对比的每一半至少有五个案例。 在每个项目内，我们按漏洞修订日期对案例排序，并以中位数将其一分为二。 然后我们比较较旧一半与较新一half的未解决率。 我们使用精确的双侧符号检验（排除并列情况）来确定这些差异是否一致地指向某一方向。 最后，我们仅报告至少有二十个尝试案例的项目的项目级未解决率，以避免基于过少案例的比较。

sents.zh: 我们还测量了失败案例随后在未经修复的情况下构建成功的频率。

paragraphs.en: Historical reconstruction frequently fails. Of the 14,159 cases we executed, 9,868 (69.7%) stopped before ARVO completed reconstruction and verification. Although their source revisions were pinned, these cases failed for various reasons, including project build failures, unavailable resources, and problems in the execution infrastructure.
paragraphs.zh: 历史重建经常失败。 在我们执行的 14,159 个案例中，有 9,868 个（69.7%）在 ARVO 完成重建和验证之前就停止了。 尽管它们的源代码修订版本已被固定，这些案例仍因各种原因而失败，包括项目构建失败、资源不可用以及执行基础设施的问题。

sents.en: Historical reconstruction frequently fails.
sents.zh: 历史重建经常失败。

sents.en: Of the 14,159 cases we executed, 9,868 (69.7%) stopped before ARVO completed reconstruction and verification.
sents.zh: 在我们执行的 14,159 个案例中，有 9,868 个（69.7%）在 ARVO 完成重建和验证之前就停止了。

sents.en: Although their source revisions were pinned, these cases failed for various reasons, including project build failures, unavailable resources, and problems in the execution infrastructure.
sents.zh: 尽管它们的源代码修订版本已被固定，这些案例仍因各种原因而失败，包括项目构建失败、资源不可用以及执行基础设施的问题。

paragraphs.en: Initial failures are highly concentrated. The 4,513 cases in the failure-analysis dataset formed 1,106 failure groups. Figure 3 ranks these groups by size. The ten largest groups covered 30.6% of the cases. The 161 groups with at least five cases covered 71.0%, whereas the 727 single-case groups account for 16.1%. Many cases therefore shared the same initial diagnosis.
paragraphs.zh: 初始失败高度集中。 失败分析数据集中的4,513个案例形成了1,106个失败组。 图3按规模对这些组进行了排序。 最大的十个组覆盖了30.6%的案例。 含至少五个案例的161个组覆盖了71.0%，而727个单案例组占16.1%。 因此，许多案例共享相同的初始诊断。

sents.en: Initial failures are highly concentrated.
sents.zh: 初始失败高度集中。

sents.en: The 4,513 cases in the failure-analysis dataset formed 1,106 failure groups.
sents.zh: 失败分析数据集中的4,513个案例形成了1,106个失败组。

sents.en: Figure 3 ranks these groups by size.
sents.zh: 图3按规模对这些组进行了排序。

sents.en: The ten largest groups covered 30.6% of the cases.
sents.zh: 最大的十个组覆盖了30.6%的案例。

sents.en: The 161 groups with at least five cases covered 71.0%, whereas the 727 single-case groups account for 16.1%.
sents.zh: 含至少五个案例的161个组覆盖了71.0%，而727个单案例组占16.1%。

sents.zh: 因此，许多案例共享相同的初始诊断。

paragraphs.en: These groups identify promising opportunities for reusable repair rules, though a repair is not guaranteed to work for every case in a group. Cases with the same initial failure may expose different blockers after that failure is removed. Conversely, a case that initially occurs alone may later match a rule derived from another group. We therefore use failure groups to identify candidates for reuse and test whether the same repair works on other cases.
paragraphs.zh: 这些分组可以识别出有前景的可复用修复规则的机会，不过并不能保证某一修复对该分组中的每个案例都有效。 具有相同初始失败的案例，在该失败被移除后可能暴露出不同的阻塞点。 反过来，最初单独出现的案例之后也可能匹配到从其他分组导出的规则。 因此，我们使用失败分组来识别可复用的候选对象，并检验相同的修复是否适用于其他案例。

paragraphs.en: Some failures disappear on re-execution. Among the 2,451 attempted cases, 286 (11.7%) later built without a repair. We could not determine why these cases succeeded on a retry. These recoveries prompted us to test whether builds that succeeded after applying rules actually needed those repairs. We report this evaluation in RQ2.
paragraphs.zh: 一些失败在重新执行后消失了。 在 2,451 个尝试案例中，有 286 个（11.7%）后来无需修复即成功构建。 我们无法确定这些案例为何在重试后成功。 这些恢复情况促使我们测试：在应用规则后成功构建的案例是否真的需要那些修复。 我们在 RQ2 中报告这一评估。

sents.en: Some failures disappear on re-execution.
sents.zh: 一些失败在重新执行后消失了。

sents.en: Among the 2,451 attempted cases, 286 (11.7%) later built without a repair.
sents.zh: 在 2,451 个尝试案例中，有 286 个（11.7%）后来无需修复即成功构建。

paragraphs.en: Build age does not predict repair outcome. We compared older and newer cases within 23 projects. Older cases had a higher unresolved rate in 5 projects and a lower rate in 10. The rates were equal in the remaining 8 projects. The mean difference in unresolved rates between the older and newer halves was -3.1 percentage points. The exact sign test gave p = 0.302 p=0.302{} , providing no evidence that older cases were harder to repair within the same project.
paragraphs.zh: 构建年龄不能预测修复结果。 我们在 23 个项目中比较了较旧与较新的案例。 在 5 个项目中，较旧案例的未解决率更高，在 10 个项目中则更低。 在其余 8 个项目中，两者的未解决率相等。 较旧半区与较新半区之间未解决率的平均差异为 -3.1 个百分点。 精确符号检验给出 p = 0.302 p=0.302{}，没有证据表明同一项目内较旧的案例更难修复。

sents.en: Build age does not predict repair outcome.
sents.zh: 构建年龄不能预测修复结果。

sents.en: We compared older and newer cases within 23 projects.
sents.zh: 我们在 23 个项目中比较了较旧与较新的案例。

sents.en: Older cases had a higher unresolved rate in 5 projects and a lower rate in 10.
sents.zh: 在 5 个项目中，较旧案例的未解决率更高，在 10 个项目中则更低。

paragraphs.en: We evaluated two consecutive phases of rule derivation. The first phase lasted approximately three months. One of the authors selected failure groups, reviewed the evidence and rules produced by the LLM, and revised the proposals when needed. During the second phase, Relay selected groups, prepared the evidence, generated candidate rules, and validated them without human intervention. This phase started with the registry produced during the human-guided work. We ran this phase until it reached approximately the same number of rule-associated recoveries as the human-guided phase. This took two weeks.
paragraphs.zh: 我们评估了规则推导的两个连续阶段。 第一阶段持续了大约三个月。 一位作者选择失败组，审查大语言模型生成的证据和规则，并在需要时修改提案。 在第二阶段，Relay 自主完成选择分组、准备证据、生成候选规则并验证规则，全程无需人工干预。 该阶段以人工引导工作期间产出的规则注册表为起点。 我们运行该阶段，直到其规则相关的恢复数量达到与人工引导阶段大致相同的水平。这一过程耗时两周。

paragraphs.en: For each failure group selected during the automated phase, Relay prepared evidence from two or three representative cases and asked GPT-5.6 Terra to propose a rule. The proposal specified both the conditions under which the rule should apply and the change it should make. Relay checked the repair scope, applied the candidate rule, and rebuilt the representative cases. If the rule restored a build or exposed a different failure, the framework added the rule to the registry and applied it to other matching cases. Relay recorded when each rule entered the registry and which successful repair chains used the rule.
paragraphs.zh: 对于自动化阶段选出的每个失败组，Relay 从两三个代表性案例中准备证据，并要求 GPT-5.6 Terra 提出一项规则。 该提案既规定了规则应适用的条件，也规定了它应做出的更改。 Relay 检查修复范围，应用候选规则，并重新构建代表性案例。 如果该规则恢复了构建或暴露出不同的失败，框架就会将该规则加入注册表，并将其应用于其他匹配的案例。 Relay 记录了每条规则进入注册表的时间，以及哪些成功的修复链使用了该规则。

paragraphs.en: Some cases built successfully on a retry without a repair, so we checked whether the rules were needed for recovery. paragraphs.en: Finally, we examined whether repaired builds preserved the behavior needed by a vulnerability benchmark. A successful build does not guarantee that the recorded input will reproduce the historical crash. ARVO encountered the same problem, including cases where the input did not trigger the crash on an archived vulnerable binary ( Mei et al., 2026 ) . We therefore compared crash-reproduction rates between rule-associated and no-patch recoveries to check whether applying rules made the historical crash less likely to reproduce. We report the difference between these rates with its 95% confidence interval. We also report how many recoveries met the benchmark-ready criteria defined in Section 4.4 .
paragraphs.zh: 最后，我们检验了修复后的构建是否保留了漏洞基准所需的行为。 构建成功并不能保证所记录的输入会复现历史上的崩溃。 ARVO 也遇到了同样的问题，包括在某些情况下输入无法在存档的易受攻击二进制文件上触发崩溃（Mei et al., 2026）。 因此，我们比较了规则关联恢复与无补丁恢复之间的崩溃复现率，以检验应用规则是否会使历史崩溃更不容易复现。 我们报告这两个比率之间的差异及其 95% 置信区间。 我们还报告了多少次恢复满足第 4.4 节中定义的基准就绪标准。

paragraphs.en: The paired control confirmed that some builds needed the repair. We identified 30 cases that failed without a repair before succeeding with a repair chain. The paired control evaluated 50 pairs. One pair encountered an infrastructure failure, leaving 49 pairs with usable results both with and without the repair. Among the 49 comparable pairs, 24 cases built successfully only with the repair. The remaining 25 succeeded both with and without it. No case succeeded only without the repair. The repair was required in 49.0% of the comparable pairs (95% Wilson CI [35.6, 62.5]). An exact McNemar test gave p = 1.2 × 10 − 7 p=1.2\times 10^{-7}{} .
paragraphs.zh: 配对对照确认部分构建需要该修复。 我们识别出 30 个在不加修复时失败、在加入修复链后成功的案例。 配对对照评估了 50 对样本。 其中一对遇到基础设施故障，剩余 49 对在有无修复两种情况下均获得了可用结果。 在这 49 个可比较的对中，有 24 个案例仅在加入修复后构建成功。 其余 25 个案例在有无修复的情况下均成功。 没有案例仅在不加修复的情况下成功。 在可比较的对中，需要该修复的比例为 49.0%（95% Wilson 置信区间 [35.6, 62.5]）。 精确 McNemar 检验给出 p = 1.2 × 10⁻⁷。

sents.en: The paired control confirmed that some builds needed the repair.
sents.zh: 配对对照确认部分构建需要该修复。

sents.en: We identified 30 cases that failed without a repair before succeeding with a repair chain.
sents.zh: 我们识别出 30 个在不加修复时失败、在加入修复链后成功的案例。

sents.en: The paired control evaluated 50 pairs.
sents.zh: 配对对照评估了 50 对样本。

sents.en: One pair encountered an infrastructure failure, leaving 49 pairs with usable results both with and without the repair.
sents.zh: 其中一对遇到基础设施故障，剩余 49 对在有无修复两种情况下均获得了可用结果。

sents.en: Among the 49 comparable pairs, 24 cases built successfully only with the repair.
sents.zh: 在这 49 个可比较的对中，有 24 个案例仅在加入修复后构建成功。

sents.en: The remaining 25 succeeded both with and without it.
sents.zh: 其余 25 个案例在有无修复的情况下均成功。

sents.en: No case succeeded only without the repair.
sents.zh: 没有案例仅在不加修复的情况下成功。

sents.en: The repair was required in 49.0% of the comparable pairs (95% Wilson CI [35.6, 62.5]).
sents.zh: 在可比较的对中，需要该修复的比例为 49.0%（95% Wilson 置信区间 [35.6, 62.5]）。

sents.en: An exact McNemar test gave p = 1.2 × 10 − 7 p=1.2\times 10^{-7}{} .
sents.zh: 精确 McNemar 检验给出 p = 1.2 × 10⁻⁷。

paragraphs.en: We examined the final repair operation before each successful build. This information was available for 415 of the 469 rule-associated recoveries. In 326 cases, the final operation changed a dependency source, package version, base image, toolchain or another part of the build environment. In 89 cases, it retried an operation or refreshed a package index or cache. The remaining 54 cases lacked enough detail to classify the final operation.
paragraphs.zh: 我们检查了每次成功构建之前的最后一次修复操作。 在469次与规则相关的恢复中，有415次可以获取该信息。 在326个案例中，最后一次操作更改了依赖源、软件包版本、基础镜像、工具链或构建环境的其他部分。 在89个案例中，它重试了某个操作，或刷新了软件包索引或缓存。 其余54个案例缺乏足够细节来对最后一次操作进行分类。

sents.en: We examined the final repair operation before each successful build.
sents.zh: 我们检查了每次成功构建之前的最后一次修复操作。

sents.en: This information was available for 415 of the 469 rule-associated recoveries.
sents.zh: 在469次与规则相关的恢复中，有415次可以获取该信息。

sents.en: In 326 cases, the final operation changed a dependency source, package version, base image, toolchain or another part of the build environment.
sents.zh: 在326个案例中，最后一次操作更改了依赖源、软件包版本、基础镜像、工具链或构建环境的其他部分。

sents.en: In 89 cases, it retried an operation or refreshed a package index or cache.
sents.zh: 在89个案例中，它重试了某个操作，或刷新了软件包索引或缓存。

sents.en: The remaining 54 cases lacked enough detail to classify the final operation.
sents.zh: 其余54个案例缺乏足够细节来对最后一次操作进行分类。

paragraphs.en: Repaired builds reproduced historical crashes at a similar rate to builds that succeeded without a repair. Table 5 reports crash reproduction and benchmark-ready outcomes. The recorded input reproduced the crash in 52.7% of rule-associated recoveries and 50.7% of no-patch recoveries. The difference was 2.0 percentage points, with a 95% confidence interval of [ − 5.3 , 9.3 ] [-5.3,9.3] . We therefore found no evidence that applying the repair rules reduced crash reproduction.
paragraphs.zh: 经修复的构建重现历史崩溃的比率与未经修复即成功构建的比率相近。 表 5 报告了崩溃重现与达到基准可用状态的结果。 在与规则关联的恢复中，记录的输入重现崩溃的比例为 52.7%；在无补丁恢复中，该比例为 50.7%。 两者相差 2.0 个百分点，95% 置信区间为 [ − 5.3 , 9.3 ] [-5.3,9.3]。 因此，我们没有发现任何证据表明应用修复规则降低了崩溃重现率。

sents.en: Repaired builds reproduced historical crashes at a similar rate to builds that succeeded without a repair.
sents.zh: 经修复的构建重现历史崩溃的比率与未经修复即成功构建的比率相近。

sents.en: Table 5 reports crash reproduction and benchmark-ready outcomes.
sents.zh: 表 5 报告了崩溃重现与达到基准可用状态的结果。

sents.en: The recorded input reproduced the crash in 52.7% of rule-associated recoveries and 50.7% of no-patch recoveries.
sents.zh: 在与规则关联的恢复中，记录的输入重现崩溃的比例为 52.7%；在无补丁恢复中，该比例为 50.7%。

sents.en: The difference was 2.0 percentage points, with a 95% confidence interval of [ − 5.3 , 9.3 ] [-5.3,9.3] .
We therefore found no evidence that applying the repair rules reduced crash reproduction.
sents.zh: 因此，我们没有发现任何证据表明应用修复规则降低了崩溃重现率。

paragraphs.en: Per-case agents can inspect one repository and adapt its environment to the failures they encounter ( Hu et al., 2025b ; Bouzenia and Pradel, 2025 ) . This raises the question of why reusable rules are needed at all. RQ3 compares rules and agents on the same failing cases and examines whether combining them improves recovery and reduces repair effort. We measure build executions, model usage, and which cases each approach restores. We also examine how widely the rules are reused and whether they repair cases outside those used during development.
paragraphs.zh: 逐案例的智能体可以检查单个仓库，并根据遇到的故障调整其环境（Hu et al., 2025b; Bouzenia and Pradel, 2025）。 这引出了一个疑问：究竟为什么还需要可复用的规则。 RQ3 在相同的失败案例上比较规则与智能体，并检验将二者结合是否能提升恢复效果并减少修复工作量。 我们测量构建执行次数、模型使用情况，以及每种方法各自恢复了哪些案例。 我们还考察规则的复用范围有多广，以及它们能否修复开发阶段所用案例之外的案例。

sents.en: Per-case agents can inspect one repository and adapt its environment to the failures they encounter ( Hu et al., 2025b ; Bouzenia and Pradel, 2025 ) .
sents.zh: 逐案例的智能体可以检查单个仓库，并根据遇到的故障调整其环境（Hu et al., 2025b; Bouzenia and Pradel, 2025）。

sents.en: This raises the question of why reusable rules are needed at all.
sents.zh: 这引出了一个疑问：究竟为什么还需要可复用的规则。

sents.en: RQ3 compares rules and agents on the same failing cases and examines whether combining them improves recovery and reduces repair effort.
sents.zh: RQ3 在相同的失败案例上比较规则与智能体，并检验将二者结合是否能提升恢复效果并减少修复工作量。

sents.en: We measure build executions, model usage, and which cases each approach restores.
sents.zh: 我们测量构建执行次数、模型使用情况，以及每种方法各自恢复了哪些案例。

sents.en: We also examine how widely the rules are reused and whether they repair cases outside those used during development.
sents.zh: 我们还考察规则的复用范围有多广，以及它们能否修复开发阶段所用案例之外的案例。

paragraphs.en: We first measured how often the same repair rule helped restore different cases, projects, and failure groups. Because a successful repair chain could contain more than one rule, we reported both recovered cases and rule credits . We gave a rule one credit each time it appeared in a successful repair chain. The number of credits can therefore exceed the number of recovered cases. We also report how many projects and baseline failure groups used each rule in a successful repair.
paragraphs.zh: 我们首先测量了同一修复规则在不同案例、项目和失败分组中帮助恢复的频率。 由于一条成功的修复链可能包含多个规则，我们同时报告了恢复的案例数和规则积分。 每当某条规则出现在一条成功的修复链中，我们就给它记一个积分。 因此积分的数量可能超过恢复案例的数量。 我们还报告了有多少项目和基线失败分组在成功修复中使用了每条规则。

sents.en: We first measured how often the same repair rule helped restore different cases, projects, and failure groups.
sents.zh: 我们首先测量了同一修复规则在不同案例、项目和失败分组中帮助恢复的频率。

sents.en: Because a successful repair chain could contain more than one rule, we reported both recovered cases and rule credits .
sents.zh: 由于一条成功的修复链可能包含多个规则，我们同时报告了恢复的案例数和规则积分。

sents.en: We gave a rule one credit each time it appeared in a successful repair chain.
sents.zh: 每当某条规则出现在一条成功的修复链中，我们就给它记一个积分。

sents.en: The number of credits can therefore exceed the number of recovered cases.
sents.zh: 因此积分的数量可能超过恢复案例的数量。

sents.en: We also report how many projects and baseline failure groups used each rule in a successful repair.
sents.zh: 我们还报告了有多少项目和基线失败分组在成功修复中使用了每条规则。

paragraphs.en: We reserved 400 previously unattempted cases to test whether the registry could repair cases outside those used during rule development. We sampled by language and failure class using a fixed seed. We excluded Swift because too few cases were available. We kept these cases out of rule derivation, validation, and subsequent repair campaigns.
paragraphs.zh: 我们保留了400个此前未曾尝试过的案例，以测试该注册表能否修复规则开发中所用案例之外的案例。 我们使用固定种子按语言和失败类别进行抽样。 我们排除了Swift，因为可用案例太少。 我们将这些案例排除在规则推导、验证以及后续的修复活动之外。

sents.en: We reserved 400 previously unattempted cases to test whether the registry could repair cases outside those used during rule development.
sents.zh: 我们保留了400个此前未曾尝试过的案例，以测试该注册表能否修复规则开发中所用案例之外的案例。

sents.en: We sampled by language and failure class using a fixed seed.
sents.zh: 我们使用固定种子按语言和失败类别进行抽样。

sents.en: We excluded Swift because too few cases were available.
sents.zh: 我们排除了Swift，因为可用案例太少。

sents.en: We kept these cases out of rule derivation, validation, and subsequent repair campaigns.
sents.zh: 我们将这些案例排除在规则推导、验证以及后续的修复活动之外。

paragraphs.en: After freezing the registry, Relay rebuilt each reserved case and checked whether an existing rule matched the observed failure. These cases came from those that remained untouched after the campaign had examined many promising failure groups. This let us test the registry on the remaining failure families rather than on additional cases from groups where the rules had already succeeded.
paragraphs.zh: 冻结注册表后，Relay 重建了每个保留的案例，并检查是否存在能匹配所观察到的失败的现有规则。 这些案例来自在探索活动检查了许多有前景的失败组之后仍未被触及的那些案例。 这让我们可以在其余的失败类别上测试注册表，而不是在规则已经成功的那几组中选取更多案例来测试。

sents.en: After freezing the registry, Relay rebuilt each reserved case and checked whether an existing rule matched the observed failure.
sents.zh: 冻结注册表后，Relay 重建了每个保留的案例，并检查是否存在能匹配所观察到的失败的现有规则。

sents.en: These cases came from those that remained untouched after the campaign had examined many promising failure groups.
sents.zh: 这些案例来自在探索活动检查了许多有前景的失败组之后仍未被触及的那些案例。

sents.en: This let us test the registry on the remaining failure families rather than on additional cases from groups where the rules had already succeeded.
sents.zh: 这让我们可以在其余的失败类别上测试注册表，而不是在规则已经成功的那几组中选取更多案例来测试。

paragraphs.en: Next, we compared the rules with per-case agents using cases that rules had restored during either campaign phase. We excluded the held-out sample and the RQ4 cases, leaving 227 candidates whose recorded failures matched a rule in the current registry. We grouped these cases by language, failure class, and failure-group size. We randomly ordered the cases within each group using a fixed seed and sampled from the groups in turn.
paragraphs.zh: 接下来，我们使用规则在任一活动阶段已恢复的用例，将规则与逐用例的智能体进行比较。 我们排除了留出样本和 RQ4 用例，留下 227 个其记录的失败与当前注册表中某条规则相匹配的候选用例。 我们按语言、失败类别和失败组规模对这些用例进行分组。 我们使用固定种子对每组内的用例进行随机排序，并依次从各组中抽样。

sents.en: Next, we compared the rules with per-case agents using cases that rules had restored during either campaign phase.
sents.zh: 接下来，我们使用规则在任一活动阶段已恢复的用例，将规则与逐用例的智能体进行比较。

sents.en: We excluded the held-out sample and the RQ4 cases, leaving 227 candidates whose recorded failures matched a rule in the current registry.
sents.zh: 我们排除了留出样本和 RQ4 用例，留下 227 个其记录的失败与当前注册表中某条规则相匹配的候选用例。

sents.en: We grouped these cases by language, failure class, and failure-group size.
sents.zh: 我们按语言、失败类别和失败组规模对这些用例进行分组。

sents.en: We randomly ordered the cases within each group using a fixed seed and sampled from the groups in turn.
sents.zh: 我们使用固定种子对每组内的用例进行随机排序，并依次从各组中抽样。

paragraphs.en: Relay rebuilt candidates without a repair in the sampling order. We retained the first 50 cases that still failed. This ensured that every case presented an active repair problem when the comparison began. We used these initial executions to select the cases and excluded them from the reported build counts.
paragraphs.zh: Relay 重建了在采样顺序中没有修复的候选对象。 我们保留了仍然失败的前 50 个用例。 这确保了每个用例在比较开始时都呈现一个活跃的修复问题。 我们使用这些初始执行来选择用例，并将它们从报告的构建计数中排除。

sents.en: Relay rebuilt candidates without a repair in the sampling order.
sents.zh: Relay 重建了在采样顺序中没有修复的候选对象。

sents.en: We retained the first 50 cases that still failed.
sents.zh: 我们保留了仍然失败的前 50 个用例。

sents.en: This ensured that every case presented an active repair problem when the comparison began.
sents.zh: 这确保了每个用例在比较开始时都呈现一个活跃的修复问题。

sents.en: We used these initial executions to select the cases and excluded them from the reported build counts.
sents.zh: 我们使用这些初始执行来选择用例，并将它们从报告的构建计数中排除。

paragraphs.en: We ran the rule registry, Qwen3.8-27B, and GPT-5.6 Terra once on each retained case. Qwen3.8 and Terra operated as per-case agents. Relay selected rules using the failure observed during the new execution. We ran the rule evaluation within one day of the agent runs to reduce changes in the external environment. We report recovered cases and build executions per recovery. For agents, we also report model calls, tokens, and hosted-model charges. We report the earlier cost of deriving the registry separately.
paragraphs.zh: 我们在每条保留案例上对规则注册表、Qwen3.8-27B 和 GPT-5.6 Terra 各运行一次。 Qwen3.8 和 Terra 作为逐案例运行的智能体。 Relay 依据新执行期间观察到的失败来选择规则。 我们在智能体运行后一天内进行规则评估，以减少外部环境的变化。 我们报告恢复的案例，并按每次恢复构建执行。 对于智能体，我们还报告模型调用次数、token 数量和托管模型费用。 我们单独报告先前推导规则注册表的成本。

sents.en: We ran the rule registry, Qwen3.8-27B, and GPT-5.6 Terra once on each retained case.
sents.zh: 我们在每条保留案例上对规则注册表、Qwen3.8-27B 和 GPT-5.6 Terra 各运行一次。

sents.en: Qwen3.8 and Terra operated as per-case agents.
sents.zh: Qwen3.8 和 Terra 作为逐案例运行的智能体。

sents.en: Relay selected rules using the failure observed during the new execution.
sents.zh: Relay 依据新执行期间观察到的失败来选择规则。

sents.en: We ran the rule evaluation within one day of the agent runs to reduce changes in the external environment.
sents.zh: 我们在智能体运行后一天内进行规则评估，以减少外部环境的变化。

sents.en: We report recovered cases and build executions per recovery.
sents.zh: 我们报告恢复的案例，并按每次恢复构建执行。

sents.en: For agents, we also report model calls, tokens, and hosted-model charges.
sents.zh: 对于智能体，我们还报告模型调用次数、token 数量和托管模型费用。

sents.en: We report the earlier cost of deriving the registry separately.
sents.zh: 我们单独报告先前推导规则注册表的成本。

paragraphs.en: We report 95% Wilson confidence intervals for the recovery rates. Because we evaluated all three approaches on the same cases, we compared their recovery outcomes using two-sided exact McNemar tests. We adjusted the three pairwise p p -values using the Holm-Bonferroni method.
paragraphs.zh: 我们报告了恢复率的95% Wilson置信区间。 由于我们在相同的案例上评估了全部三种方法，我们使用双侧精确McNemar检验比较了它们的恢复结果。 我们使用Holm-Bonferroni方法对三个两两比较的p p-值进行了校正。

sents.en: We report 95% Wilson confidence intervals for the recovery rates.
sents.zh: 我们报告了恢复率的95% Wilson置信区间。

sents.en: Because we evaluated all three approaches on the same cases, we compared their recovery outcomes using two-sided exact McNemar tests.
sents.zh: 由于我们在相同的案例上评估了全部三种方法，我们使用双侧精确McNemar检验比较了它们的恢复结果。

sents.en: We adjusted the three pairwise p p -values using the Holm-Bonferroni method.
sents.zh: 我们使用Holm-Bonferroni方法对三个两两比较的p p-值进行了校正。

paragraphs.en: Finally, we estimated the result of running the rules first and sending only the remaining cases to an agent. For each case the rules did not restore, we used the agent result and resource usage already observed for that case. Each agent started from the initial failure and did not inherit edits made by the rules. RQ4 evaluates agent escalation after deterministic repair stops.
paragraphs.zh: 最后，我们估计了先运行规则、再将剩余案例交给智能体的运行结果。 对于规则未能修复的每个案例，我们使用该案例已观测到的智能体结果和资源消耗。 每个智能体都从初始故障开始，不会继承规则所做的编辑。 RQ4 评估确定性修复停止后的智能体升级。

sents.en: Finally, we estimated the result of running the rules first and sending only the remaining cases to an agent.
sents.zh: 最后，我们估计了先运行规则、再将剩余案例交给智能体的运行结果。

sents.en: For each case the rules did not restore, we used the agent result and resource usage already observed for that case.
sents.zh: 对于规则未能修复的每个案例，我们使用该案例已观测到的智能体结果和资源消耗。

sents.en: Each agent started from the initial failure and did not inherit edits made by the rules.
sents.zh: 每个智能体都从初始故障开始，不会继承规则所做的编辑。

sents.en: RQ4 evaluates agent escalation after deterministic repair stops.
sents.zh: RQ4 评估确定性修复停止后的智能体升级。

paragraphs.en: A single derivation can serve many cases. Of the 408 rules applied during the campaigns, 52 contributed to successful repair chains that restored 469 cases. The 20 most frequently reused rules accounted for 85% of all rule credits. 26 rules helped restore builds across at least three projects and accounted for 55.8% of the credits. For example, a rule that redirects unavailable GDAL netCDF archives contributed to 67 recoveries. Once Relay validates a rule, it can apply that rule to other matching cases without further model calls.
paragraphs.zh: 单条推导可以服务于许多案例。 在活动期间应用的 408 条规则中，有 52 条为成功修复链做出了贡献，恢复了 469 个案例。 复用频率最高的 20 条规则占所有规则贡献的 85%。有 26 条规则帮助恢复了至少三个项目的构建，占贡献的 55.8%。 例如，一条重定向不可用 GDAL netCDF 归档的规则促成了 67 次恢复。 一旦系统验证了某条规则，它就可以将该规则应用于其他匹配的案例，而无需进一步的模型调用。

sents.en: A single derivation can serve many cases.
sents.zh: 单条推导可以服务于许多案例。

sents.en: Of the 408 rules applied during the campaigns, 52 contributed to successful repair chains that restored 469 cases.
sents.zh: 在活动期间应用的 408 条规则中，有 52 条为成功修复链做出了贡献，恢复了 469 个案例。

sents.en: The 20 most frequently reused rules accounted for 85% of all rule credits. 26 rules helped restore builds across at least three projects and accounted for 55.8% of the credits.
sents.zh: 复用频率最高的 20 条规则占所有规则贡献的 85%。有 26 条规则帮助恢复了至少三个项目的构建，占贡献的 55.8%。

sents.en: For example, a rule that redirects unavailable GDAL netCDF archives contributed to 67 recoveries.
sents.zh: 例如，一条重定向不可用 GDAL netCDF 归档的规则促成了 67 次恢复。

sents.en: Once Relay validates a rule, it can apply that rule to other matching cases without further model calls.
sents.zh: 一旦系统验证了某条规则，它就可以将该规则应用于其他匹配的案例，而无需进一步的模型调用。

paragraphs.en: The registry did not restore the held-out cases. Table 6 reports the results for the 400 held-out cases. For 376 cases, no rule matched the observed failure. paragraphs.en: The automated campaign spent $53.07 on model calls to derive rules, including proposals that did not enter the registry. Dividing this cost by the campaign’s 238 rule-associated recoveries gives approximately $0.22 per recovery. Applying validated rules to further cases requires no additional model calls.
paragraphs.zh: 自动化活动在模型调用上花费了 53.07 美元用于推导规则，其中包括未进入注册表的提案。 将该成本除以此次活动的 238 次与规则相关的恢复，可得出每次恢复约需 0.22 美元。 将已验证的规则应用于更多案例时，无需额外的模型调用。
