paragraphs.en: Rules restored similar numbers of builds with fewer executions. Table 7 compares the three approaches on the 50 failing cases. The rules restored 30 cases, compared with 26 for Qwen3.8 and 24 for GPT-5.6 Terra. Their recovery rates were 60.0%, 52.0%, and 48.0%, respectively. The corresponding 95% Wilson confidence intervals were [46.2, 72.4] for the rules, [38.5, 65.2] for Qwen3.8, and [34.8, 61.5] for Terra. None of the pairwise differences was statistically significant after the Holm-Bonferroni adjustment (adjusted p ≥ 0.789 p\geq 0.789{} ).
paragraphs.zh: 规则以更少的执行次数恢复了相近数量的构建。 表 7 比较了三种方法在 50 个失败用例上的表现。 规则恢复了 30 个用例，相比之下 Qwen3.8 恢复了 26 个，GPT-5.6 Terra 恢复了 24 个。 它们的恢复率分别为 60.0%、52.0% 和 48.0%。 相应的 95% Wilson 置信区间为：规则 [46.2, 72.4]，Qwen3.8 [38.5, 65.2]，Terra [34.8, 61.5]。 经 Holm-Bonferroni 校正后，两两差异均无统计学意义（校正后 p ≥ 0.789 p\geq 0.789{} ）。

sents.zh: 规则以更少的执行次数恢复了相近数量的构建。

sents.en: Table 7 compares the three approaches on the 50 failing cases.

paragraphs.en: The rules required 1.57 builds per restored case, compared with 5.58 for Qwen3.8 and 3.67 for Terra. The agents therefore used 2.3 to 3.6 times as many builds per recovery. Qwen3.8 made 1,096 model calls and used 14.8M tokens. Terra made 550 calls, used 16.6M tokens, and cost $10.53. After excluding 3 cases affected by Qwen3.8 harness failures, we compared the remaining 47 cases across all three approaches. The rules restored 28, Qwen3.8 restored 25, and Terra restored 22.

paragraphs.en: Rules and agents restored different cases. The rules restored 13 cases that Qwen3.8 missed and 13 that Terra missed. Agent escalation therefore added coverage.

sents.en: Rules and agents restored different cases.
sents.zh: 规则与智能体各自恢复了许多不同的用例。

paragraphs.en: Combining rules and agents improved recovery and reduced agent work. We combined the recorded rule results with Qwen3.8’s results on the cases the rules did not restore. This gave 39 recoveries using 111 builds, compared with 26 recoveries and 145 builds for Qwen3.8 alone. Sending only the unresolved cases to Qwen3.8 reduced token use from 14.8M to 6.3M.
paragraphs.zh: 结合规则与智能体提高了恢复率并减少了智能体的工作量。 我们将记录的规则结果与 Qwen3.8 在规则未能恢复的用例上的结果相结合。 这一方法使用 111 次构建实现了 39 次恢复，而单独使用 Qwen3.8 则需要 145 次构建仅实现 26 次恢复。 仅将未解决的用例发送给 Qwen3.8 使 token 用量从 14.8M 降低到 6.3M。

sents.en: Combining rules and agents improved recovery and reduced agent work.
sents.zh: 结合规则与智能体提高了恢复率并减少了智能体的工作量。

sents.en: We combined the recorded rule results with Qwen3.8’s results on the cases the rules did not restore.
sents.zh: 我们将记录的规则结果与 Qwen3.8 在规则未能恢复的用例上的结果相结合。

sents.zh: 这一方法使用 111 次构建实现了 39 次恢复，而单独使用 Qwen3.8 则需要 145 次构建仅实现 26 次恢复。

sents.zh: 仅将未解决的用例发送给 Qwen3.8 使 token 用量从 14.8M 降低到 6.3M。

paragraphs.en: Combining the recorded rule results with Terra’s results on unresolved cases gave 37 recoveries using 83 builds. Terra alone restored 24 cases using 88 builds. The combination reduced token use from 16.6M to 7.2M and API charges from $10.53 to $4.41.
paragraphs.zh: 将记录的规则结果与 Terra 在未解决案例上的结果相结合，使用 83 个构建获得了 37 次恢复。 仅使用 Terra 就恢复了 24 个案例，使用了 88 个构建。 这种组合将 token 使用量从 1660 万减少到 720 万，API 费用从 10.53 美元降低到 4.41 美元。

sents.en: Combining the recorded rule results with Terra’s results on unresolved cases gave 37 recoveries using 83 builds.
sents.zh: 将记录的规则结果与 Terra 在未解决案例上的结果相结合，使用 83 个构建获得了 37 次恢复。

sents.en: Terra alone restored 24 cases using 88 builds.
sents.zh: 仅使用 Terra 就恢复了 24 个案例，使用了 88 个构建。

sents.en: The combination reduced token use from 16.6M to 7.2M and API charges from $10.53 to $4.41.

paragraphs.en: RQ3 showed that rules and agents restore different cases and that using the rules first can reduce agent work. Relay escalates unresolved cases after deterministic repair stops. RQ4 examines the cases that reach this point. We first identify why rule-based repair stops and whether per-case agents can repair the unresolved cases.
paragraphs.zh: RQ3 表明规则与智能体修复的是不同的案例，先使用规则可以减少智能体的工作量。 在确定性修复停止后，Relay 会将未解决的案例上报。 RQ4 考察的是到达这一节点的案例。 我们首先分析基于规则的修复为何停止，以及逐案例的智能体能否修复这些未解决的案例。

sents.en: RQ3 showed that rules and agents restore different cases and that using the rules first can reduce agent work.
sents.zh: RQ3 表明规则与智能体修复的是不同的案例，先使用规则可以减少智能体的工作量。

sents.en: Relay escalates unresolved cases after deterministic repair stops.
sents.zh: 在确定性修复停止后，Relay 会将未解决的案例上报。

sents.en: RQ4 examines the cases that reach this point.
sents.zh: RQ4 考察的是到达这一节点的案例。

sents.en: We first identify why rule-based repair stops and whether per-case agents can repair the unresolved cases.
sents.zh: 我们首先分析基于规则的修复为何停止，以及逐案例的智能体能否修复这些未解决的案例。

paragraphs.en: We first examined cases where a rule matched the failure but could not apply its edit to the project’s build files. We counted these application failures across all recorded attempts and manually inspected the logs and repair specifications for 124 affected cases to identify why the edits failed.
paragraphs.zh: 我们首先考察了规则匹配到故障但无法将其编辑应用于项目构建文件的情形。 我们统计了所有记录尝试中的这些应用失败案例，并人工检查了 124 个受影响案例的日志和修复规范，以找出编辑失败的原因。

sents.en: We first examined cases where a rule matched the failure but could not apply its edit to the project’s build files.
sents.zh: 我们首先考察了规则匹配到故障但无法将其编辑应用于项目构建文件的情形。

sents.en: We counted these application failures across all recorded attempts and manually inspected the logs and repair specifications for 124 affected cases to identify why the edits failed.
sents.zh: 我们统计了所有记录尝试中的这些应用失败案例，并人工检查了 124 个受影响案例的日志和修复规范，以找出编辑失败的原因。

paragraphs.en: We also examined whether the derivation loop repeatedly proposed variations of the same repair without restoring the build. We identified 5 recurring strategies: Rust nightly and RUSTC_BOOTSTRAP handling, Go toolchain installation, retired Go base builders, retired Rust base builders, and Kubernetes Go toolchain handling. For each strategy, we compared how often its rules exposed a different failure with how often they restored a build.
paragraphs.zh: 我们还检查了派生循环是否在未恢复构建的情况下，反复提出同一修复的多种变体。 我们识别出5种反复出现的策略：Rust nightly 与 RUSTC_BOOTSTRAP 处理、Go 工具链安装、已退役的 Go 基础构建器、已退役的 Rust 基础构建器，以及 Kubernetes 的 Go 工具链处理。 对于每种策略，我们将其规则暴露出不同失败的频率与恢复构建的频率进行了比较。

sents.en: We also examined whether the derivation loop repeatedly proposed variations of the same repair without restoring the build.
sents.zh: 我们还检查了派生循环是否在未恢复构建的情况下，反复提出同一修复的多种变体。

sents.en: We identified 5 recurring strategies: Rust nightly and RUSTC_BOOTSTRAP handling, Go toolchain installation, retired Go base builders, retired Rust base builders, and Kubernetes Go toolchain handling.
sents.zh: 我们识别出5种反复出现的策略：Rust nightly 与 RUSTC_BOOTSTRAP 处理、Go 工具链安装、已退役的 Go 基础构建器、已退役的 Rust 基础构建器，以及 Kubernetes 的 Go 工具链处理。

sents.en: For each strategy, we compared how often its rules exposed a different failure with how often they restored a build.
sents.zh: 对于每种策略，我们将其规则暴露出不同失败的频率与恢复构建的频率进行了比较。

paragraphs.en: We selected 60 unresolved cases to test whether agents could repair them after deterministic repair stopped. The sample included 30 rule-exhausted cases, where the loop had tried every matching rule, and 30 scope-limited cases, where the evidence suggested that a repair required a case-specific choice our general rules could not express. We excluded cases blocked by unavailable external resources or infrastructure failures, since these prevented the agent from testing a repair.
paragraphs.zh: 我们选取了60个未解决的案例，以测试在确定性修复停止后，智能体能否对其完成修复。 该样本包含30个规则耗尽型案例，即循环已尝试过所有匹配规则；以及30个范围受限型案例，即证据表明修复需要一种我们的通用规则无法表达的、针对具体案例的选择。 我们排除了因外部资源不可用或基础设施故障而被阻塞的案例，因为这些情况使智能体无法对修复进行测试。

sents.en: We selected 60 unresolved cases to test whether agents could repair them after deterministic repair stopped.
sents.zh: 我们选取了60个未解决的案例，以测试在确定性修复停止后，智能体能否对其完成修复。

sents.en: The sample included 30 rule-exhausted cases, where the loop had tried every matching rule, and 30 scope-limited cases, where the evidence suggested that a repair required a case-specific choice our general rules could not express.
sents.zh: 该样本包含30个规则耗尽型案例，即循环已尝试过所有匹配规则；以及30个范围受限型案例，即证据表明修复需要一种我们的通用规则无法表达的、针对具体案例的选择。

sents.en: We excluded cases blocked by unavailable external resources or infrastructure failures, since these prevented the agent from testing a repair.
sents.zh: 我们排除了因外部资源不可用或基础设施故障而被阻塞的案例，因为这些情况使智能体无法对修复进行测试。

paragraphs.en: Before running the agents, Relay rebuilt all 60 cases without a repair. We excluded 3 cases that built successfully and evaluated the three main models on the remaining 57 failing cases. We ran Qwen3.8-27B, Qwen3.6-27B, and GPT-5.6 Terra on the same 57 cases. The two Qwen models have the same size, allowing us to compare model generations with the same settings. We also tested Terra, which had proposed the repair rules, as a per-case agent. To examine whether a more capable model could repair additional cases, we ran GPT-5.6 Sol on a diagnostic subset of 15 cases. We selected 3 cases that Qwen3.8 had restored, 6 where it had stopped early, and 6 where it had changed the failure without restoring the build. We report 95% Wilson confidence intervals for the recovery rates. Because we evaluated the three main models on the same cases, we compared their recovery outcomes using two-sided exact McNemar tests. We adjusted the three pairwise p p -values using the Holm-Bonferroni method.
paragraphs.zh: 在运行智能体之前，Relay 在没有修复的情况下重新构建了全部 60 个案例。 我们排除了 3 个构建成功的案例，并在其余 57 个失败案例上评估了三个主要模型。 我们在相同的 57 个案例上运行了 Qwen3.8-27B、Qwen3.6-27B 和 GPT-5.6 Terra。 两个 Qwen 模型具有相同的规模，使我们能够在相同设置下比较不同代际的模型。 我们还测试了曾提出修复规则的 Terra 作为单案例智能体。 为了考察更强大的模型能否修复更多案例，我们在 15 个案例的诊断子集上运行了 GPT-5.6 Sol。 我们选择了 Qwen3.8 已恢复构建的 3 个案例、提前停止的 6 个案例，以及改变了失败情况但未恢复构建的 6 个案例。 我们报告恢复率的 95% Wilson 置信区间。 由于我们在相同的案例上评估了三个主要模型，因此使用双侧精确 McNemar 检验来比较它们的恢复结果。 我们使用 Holm-Bonferroni 方法对三组两两比较的 p p 值进行了校正。

sents.zh: 在运行智能体之前，Relay 在没有修复的情况下重新构建了全部 60 个案例。

sents.zh: 我们在相同的 57 个案例上运行了 Qwen3.8-27B、Qwen3.6-27B 和 GPT-5.6 Terra。

sents.en: To examine whether a more capable model could repair additional cases, we ran GPT-5.6 Sol on a diagnostic subset of 15 cases.
sents.zh: 为了考察更强大的模型能否修复更多案例，我们在 15 个案例的诊断子集上运行了 GPT-5.6 Sol。

sents.en: We selected 3 cases that Qwen3.8 had restored, 6 where it had stopped early, and 6 where it had changed the failure without restoring the build.
sents.zh: 我们选择了 Qwen3.8 已恢复构建的 3 个案例、提前停止的 6 个案例，以及改变了失败情况但未恢复构建的 6 个案例。

sents.en: We report 95% Wilson confidence intervals for the recovery rates.
sents.zh: 我们报告恢复率的 95% Wilson 置信区间。

sents.en: Because we evaluated the three main models on the same cases, we compared their recovery outcomes using two-sided exact McNemar tests.
sents.zh: 由于我们在相同的案例上评估了三个主要模型，因此使用双侧精确 McNemar 检验来比较它们的恢复结果。

sents.en: We adjusted the three pairwise p p -values using the Holm-Bonferroni method.
sents.zh: 我们使用 Holm-Bonferroni 方法对三组两两比较的 p p 值进行了校正。

paragraphs.en: Rules sometimes matched a failure but could not apply the repair. The applicator failed to make the requested edit in 583 of 6,201 recorded attempts (9.4%). These failures affected 374 cases, of which 253 remained unresolved. We manually inspected 124 affected cases. In 122 cases, the applicator could not find the text or insertion point specified by the rule. These included 48 replacements, 35 insertions before a missing line, and 39 insertions after a missing line. Supporting more build-file layouts could therefore allow the applicator to attempt these repairs on more cases.
paragraphs.zh: 规则有时匹配到了失败，却无法应用修复。 在 6,201 次记录在案的尝试中，应用器有 583 次（9.4%）未能完成所请求的编辑。 这些失败影响了 374 个案例，其中 253 个仍未解决。 我们人工检查了 124 个受影响的案例。 在 122 个案例中，应用器无法找到规则所指定的文本或插入点。 其中包括 48 次替换、35 次在缺失行之前的插入，以及 39 次在缺失行之后的插入。 因此，支持更多构建文件布局可以让应用器在更多案例上尝试这些修复。

sents.en: Rules sometimes matched a failure but could not apply the repair.
sents.zh: 规则有时匹配到了失败，却无法应用修复。

sents.en: The applicator failed to make the requested edit in 583 of 6,201 recorded attempts (9.4%).
sents.zh: 在 6,201 次记录在案的尝试中，应用器有 583 次（9.4%）未能完成所请求的编辑。

sents.en: These failures affected 374 cases, of which 253 remained unresolved.
sents.zh: 这些失败影响了 374 个案例，其中 253 个仍未解决。

sents.en: We manually inspected 124 affected cases.
sents.zh: 我们人工检查了 124 个受影响的案例。

sents.en: In 122 cases, the applicator could not find the text or insertion point specified by the rule.
sents.zh: 在 122 个案例中，应用器无法找到规则所指定的文本或插入点。

sents.en: These included 48 replacements, 35 insertions before a missing line, and 39 insertions after a missing line.
sents.zh: 其中包括 48 次替换、35 次在缺失行之前的插入，以及 39 次在缺失行之后的插入。

sents.en: Supporting more build-file layouts could therefore allow the applicator to attempt these repairs on more cases.
sents.zh: 因此，支持更多构建文件布局可以让应用器在更多案例上尝试这些修复。

paragraphs.en: The derivation loop sometimes repeated repairs without restoring a build. The registry contained 136 rule identifiers for the 5 strategies described above. For three of these strategies, 51 identifiers exposed a different failure 575 times without restoring a build. Go toolchain installation and Rust nightly handling restored 54 and 22 cases, but only 3 identifiers contributed to those recoveries. Relay limits further attempts when no eligible rule remains or successive attempts return the same failure.
paragraphs.zh: 推导循环有时会重复修复操作，而未能恢复构建。 注册表中包含 136 个规则标识符，对应上述 5 种策略。 对于其中三种策略，51 个标识符共 575 次暴露了不同的失败，而未能恢复构建。 Go 工具链安装和 Rust nightly 处理分别恢复了 54 和 22 个案例，但只有 3 个标识符促成了这些恢复。 当没有符合条件的规则留存或连续尝试返回相同失败时，Relay 会限制进一步的尝试。

sents.en: The derivation loop sometimes repeated repairs without restoring a build.
sents.zh: 推导循环有时会重复修复操作，而未能恢复构建。

sents.en: The registry contained 136 rule identifiers for the 5 strategies described above.
sents.zh: 注册表中包含 136 个规则标识符，对应上述 5 种策略。

sents.en: For three of these strategies, 51 identifiers exposed a different failure 575 times without restoring a build.
sents.zh: 对于其中三种策略，51 个标识符共 575 次暴露了不同的失败，而未能恢复构建。

sents.en: Go toolchain installation and Rust nightly handling restored 54 and 22 cases, but only 3 identifiers contributed to those recoveries.
sents.zh: Go 工具链安装和 Rust nightly 处理分别恢复了 54 和 22 个案例，但只有 3 个标识符促成了这些恢复。

sents.en: Relay limits further attempts when no eligible rule remains or successive attempts return the same failure.
sents.zh: 当没有符合条件的规则留存或连续尝试返回相同失败时，Relay 会限制进一步的尝试。

paragraphs.en: Agents restored additional cases after deterministic repair stopped. Table 8 reports results on the 57 cases. Qwen3.8 restored 16, Qwen3.6 restored 14, and Terra restored 10, giving recovery rates of 28.1%, 24.6%, and 17.5%, respectively. The recorded input reproduced the historical crash in 10, 11, and 7 of those recoveries, respectively.
paragraphs.zh: 在确定性修复停止后，智能体恢复了额外的案例。 表8报告了这57个案例上的结果。 Qwen3.8恢复了16个，Qwen3.6恢复了14个，Terra恢复了10个，恢复率分别为28.1%、24.6%和17.5%。 在这些恢复中，记录的输入分别复现了10个、11个和7个案例的历史崩溃。

sents.en: Agents restored additional cases after deterministic repair stopped.
sents.zh: 在确定性修复停止后，智能体恢复了额外的案例。

sents.en: Table 8 reports results on the 57 cases.
sents.zh: 表8报告了这57个案例上的结果。

sents.en: Qwen3.8 restored 16, Qwen3.6 restored 14, and Terra restored 10, giving recovery rates of 28.1%, 24.6%, and 17.5%, respectively.
sents.zh: Qwen3.8恢复了16个，Qwen3.6恢复了14个，Terra恢复了10个，恢复率分别为28.1%、24.6%和17.5%。

sents.en: The recorded input reproduced the historical crash in 10, 11, and 7 of those recoveries, respectively.
sents.zh: 在这些恢复中，记录的输入分别复现了10个、11个和7个案例的历史崩溃。

paragraphs.en: None of the differences between models was statistically significant after the Holm-Bonferroni correction. The largest difference was between Qwen3.8 and Terra: Qwen3.8 restored 6 cases that Terra did not, while Terra restored none that Qwen3.8 missed. The raw p p -value was 0.031, and the adjusted p p -value was 0.094. The other adjusted p p -values were at least 0.688. All three models restored 7 of the same cases, and 20 were restored by at least one model.
paragraphs.zh: 经 Holm-Bonferroni 校正后，各模型之间的差异均无统计学意义。 最大差异出现在 Qwen3.8 与 Terra 之间：Qwen3.8 恢复了 Terra 未能恢复的 6 个案例，而 Terra 没有恢复任何 Qwen3.8 遗漏的案例。 原始 p p 值为 0.031，校正后的 p p 值为 0.094。 其余校正后的 p p 值均不低于 0.688。 三个模型均恢复了相同的 7 个案例，共有 20 个案例被至少一个模型恢复。

sents.en: None of the differences between models was statistically significant after the Holm-Bonferroni correction.
sents.zh: 经 Holm-Bonferroni 校正后，各模型之间的差异均无统计学意义。

sents.en: The largest difference was between Qwen3.8 and Terra: Qwen3.8 restored 6 cases that Terra did not, while Terra restored none that Qwen3.8 missed.
sents.zh: 最大差异出现在 Qwen3.8 与 Terra 之间：Qwen3.8 恢复了 Terra 未能恢复的 6 个案例，而 Terra 没有恢复任何 Qwen3.8 遗漏的案例。

sents.en: The raw p p -value was 0.031, and the adjusted p p -value was 0.094.
sents.zh: 原始 p p 值为 0.031，校正后的 p p 值为 0.094。

sents.en: The other adjusted p p -values were at least 0.688.
sents.zh: 其余校正后的 p p 值均不低于 0.688。

sents.en: All three models restored 7 of the same cases, and 20 were restored by at least one model.
sents.zh: 三个模型均恢复了相同的 7 个案例，共有 20 个案例被至少一个模型恢复。

paragraphs.en: The execution harness did not produce a reliable outcome for 4 cases. After excluding the affected runs, we retained 55 usable Qwen3.8 results, 56 Qwen3.6 results, and 56 Terra results. None of the excluded runs was counted as a recovery, so the total number of recoveries remained unchanged.
paragraphs.zh: 执行测试框架未能为 4 个案例产生可靠的结果。 在排除受影响的运行后，我们保留了 55 个可用的 Qwen3.8 结果、56 个 Qwen3.6 结果和 56 个 Terra 结果。 被排除的运行均未被计作恢复，因此恢复的总数保持不变。

sents.en: The execution harness did not produce a reliable outcome for 4 cases.
sents.zh: 执行测试框架未能为 4 个案例产生可靠的结果。

sents.en: After excluding the affected runs, we retained 55 usable Qwen3.8 results, 56 Qwen3.6 results, and 56 Terra results.
sents.zh: 在排除受影响的运行后，我们保留了 55 个可用的 Qwen3.8 结果、56 个 Qwen3.6 结果和 56 个 Terra 结果。

sents.en: None of the excluded runs was counted as a recovery, so the total number of recoveries remained unchanged.
sents.zh: 被排除的运行均未被计作恢复，因此恢复的总数保持不变。

paragraphs.en: Although the models received the same limits, they used their budgets differently. The token limit stopped 11 Qwen3.8 runs, 26 Qwen3.6 runs, and 19 Terra runs. Qwen3.8 required 9.75 builds per recovery, Qwen3.6 required 9.14, and Terra required 7.80. Terra cost $1.45 per recovered case.
paragraphs.zh: 尽管各模型收到了相同的限制，但它们以不同的方式使用了各自的预算。 令牌限制使 11 次 Qwen3.8 运行、26 次 Qwen3.6 运行和 19 次 Terra 运行中止。 Qwen3.8 每次恢复需要 9.75 次构建，Qwen3.6 需要 9.14 次，Terra 需要 7.80 次。 Terra 每恢复一个案例的成本为 1.45 美元。

sents.en: Although the models received the same limits, they used their budgets differently.
sents.zh: 尽管各模型收到了相同的限制，但它们以不同的方式使用了各自的预算。

sents.en: The token limit stopped 11 Qwen3.8 runs, 26 Qwen3.6 runs, and 19 Terra runs.
sents.zh: 令牌限制使 11 次 Qwen3.8 运行、26 次 Qwen3.6 运行和 19 次 Terra 运行中止。

sents.en: Qwen3.8 required 9.75 builds per recovery, Qwen3.6 required 9.14, and Terra required 7.80.
sents.zh: Qwen3.8 每次恢复需要 9.75 次构建，Qwen3.6 需要 9.14 次，Terra 需要 7.80 次。

sents.en: Terra cost $1.45 per recovered case.
sents.zh: Terra 每恢复一个案例的成本为 1.45 美元。

paragraphs.en: In some cases, the models’ explanations for stopping were not supported by empirical evidence. We checked 28 cases where a model stopped after reporting an infrastructure problem or an unavailable resource. Another model restored 3 of these cases. We therefore treat these explanations as each model’s assessment rather than verified causes.
paragraphs.zh: 在某些情况下，模型给出的停止解释缺乏实证证据支持。 我们检查了28个案例，这些案例中模型在报告基础设施问题或资源不可用后停止了运行。 另一个智能体恢复了其中3个案例。 因此，我们将这些解释视为每个智能体自身的评估，而非经过验证的原因。

sents.en: In some cases, the models’ explanations for stopping were not supported by empirical evidence.
sents.zh: 在某些情况下，模型给出的停止解释缺乏实证证据支持。

sents.en: We checked 28 cases where a model stopped after reporting an infrastructure problem or an unavailable resource.
sents.zh: 我们检查了28个案例，这些案例中模型在报告基础设施问题或资源不可用后停止了运行。

sents.en: Another model restored 3 of these cases.
sents.zh: 另一个智能体恢复了其中3个案例。

sents.en: We therefore treat these explanations as each model’s assessment rather than verified causes.
sents.zh: 因此，我们将这些解释视为每个智能体自身的评估，而非经过验证的原因。

paragraphs.en: The flagship model did not improve recovery on the diagnostic subset. Of the 15 selected cases, 2 built without a repair when re-executed. This left 13 cases for the comparison. The provider rejected one case under its cybersecurity policy, so Sol completed 12 runs. Sol restored 4 cases, compared with 4 for Qwen3.8, 5 for Qwen3.6, and 2 for Terra. None of the pairwise differences was statistically significant, with all raw p p -values being at least 0.375. Every case restored by Sol was also restored by at least one other model. Sol used 16 builds, 140 model calls, and 6.1M tokens. Its API usage cost $7.68. The recorded input reproduced the historical crash in 3 of Sol’s recoveries.
paragraphs.zh: 旗舰模型在诊断子集上没有改善恢复效果。 在选出的 15 个案例中，有 2 个在重新执行时构建没有修复。 这留下了 13 个案例用于比较。 提供商以网络安全政策为由拒绝了一个案例，因此 Sol 完成了 12 次运行。 Sol 恢复了 4 个案例，相比之下 Qwen3.8 恢复了 4 个，Qwen3.6 恢复了 5 个，Terra 恢复了 2 个。 任何两两之间的差异都不具有统计显著性，所有原始 p 值至少为 0.375。 Sol 恢复的每个案例也都被至少一个其他模型恢复。 Sol 使用了 16 次构建、140 次模型调用和 6.1M token。 其 API 使用成本为 7.68 美元。 记录的输入在 Sol 的 3 次恢复中复现了历史崩溃。

sents.en: The flagship model did not improve recovery on the diagnostic subset.
sents.zh: 旗舰模型在诊断子集上没有改善恢复效果。

sents.en: Of the 15 selected cases, 2 built without a repair when re-executed.
sents.zh: 在选出的 15 个案例中，有 2 个在重新执行时构建没有修复。

sents.en: This left 13 cases for the comparison.
sents.zh: 这留下了 13 个案例用于比较。

sents.en: The provider rejected one case under its cybersecurity policy, so Sol completed 12 runs.
sents.zh: 提供商以网络安全政策为由拒绝了一个案例，因此 Sol 完成了 12 次运行。

sents.en: Sol restored 4 cases, compared with 4 for Qwen3.8, 5 for Qwen3.6, and 2 for Terra.
sents.zh: Sol 恢复了 4 个案例，相比之下 Qwen3.8 恢复了 4 个，Qwen3.6 恢复了 5 个，Terra 恢复了 2 个。

sents.en: None of the pairwise differences was statistically significant, with all raw p p -values being at least 0.375.
sents.zh: 任何两两之间的差异都不具有统计显著性，所有原始 p 值至少为 0.375。

sents.en: Every case restored by Sol was also restored by at least one other model.
sents.zh: Sol 恢复的每个案例也都被至少一个其他模型恢复。

sents.en: Sol used 16 builds, 140 model calls, and 6.1M tokens.
sents.zh: Sol 使用了 16 次构建、140 次模型调用和 6.1M token。

sents.en: Its API usage cost $7.68.
sents.zh: 其 API 使用成本为 7.68 美元。

sents.en: The recorded input reproduced the historical crash in 3 of Sol’s recoveries.
sents.zh: 记录的输入在 Sol 的 3 次恢复中复现了历史崩溃。

paragraphs.en: Rules and per-case agents both use model reasoning to decide how to repair a build. A per-case agent repeats that reasoning for every build. Relay uses evidence from representative failures to derive a rule that specifies when a repair applies and what to change. Once validated, the rule can be inspected and applied to other matching cases without further model calls.
paragraphs.zh: 规则和逐案例智能体都使用模型推理来决定如何修复构建。 逐案例智能体会为每一次构建重复该推理。 Relay 利用代表性故障中的证据来推导规则，该规则规定修复何时适用以及要修改什么。 一经验证，该规则即可被检查并应用于其他匹配的案例，而无需再进行模型调用。

sents.en: Rules and per-case agents both use model reasoning to decide how to repair a build.
sents.zh: 规则和逐案例智能体都使用模型推理来决定如何修复构建。

sents.en: A per-case agent repeats that reasoning for every build.
sents.zh: 逐案例智能体会为每一次构建重复该推理。

sents.en: Relay uses evidence from representative failures to derive a rule that specifies when a repair applies and what to change.
sents.zh: Relay 利用代表性故障中的证据来推导规则，该规则规定修复何时适用以及要修改什么。

sents.en: Once validated, the rule can be inspected and applied to other matching cases without further model calls.
sents.zh: 一经验证，该规则即可被检查并应用于其他匹配的案例，而无需再进行模型调用。

paragraphs.en: Our paired evaluation supports using rules before agents. The rules restored similar numbers of cases with fewer build executions, while agents restored additional cases that the rules missed. Combining the recorded outcomes gave 37 to 39 recoveries out of 50 cases, using fewer builds and less than half the agent tokens of an agent alone. Rules handled recurring failures efficiently, while agent escalation provided flexibility on the remaining cases.
paragraphs.zh: 我们的配对评估支持在智能体之前使用规则。 规则以更少的构建执行恢复了数量相近的案例，而智能体则恢复了规则遗漏的额外案例。 结合记录的结果，在50个案例中获得了37到39次恢复，同时使用的构建更少，智能体令牌用量不到单独使用智能体的一半。 规则高效地处理了重复出现的故障，而智能体升级为其余案例提供了灵活性。

sents.en: Our paired evaluation supports using rules before agents.
sents.zh: 我们的配对评估支持在智能体之前使用规则。

sents.en: The rules restored similar numbers of cases with fewer build executions, while agents restored additional cases that the rules missed.
sents.zh: 规则以更少的构建执行恢复了数量相近的案例，而智能体则恢复了规则遗漏的额外案例。

sents.en: Combining the recorded outcomes gave 37 to 39 recoveries out of 50 cases, using fewer builds and less than half the agent tokens of an agent alone.
sents.zh: 结合记录的结果，在50个案例中获得了37到39次恢复，同时使用的构建更少，智能体令牌用量不到单独使用智能体的一半。

sents.en: Rules handled recurring failures efficiently, while agent escalation provided flexibility on the remaining cases.
sents.zh: 规则高效地处理了重复出现的故障，而智能体升级为其余案例提供了灵活性。

paragraphs.en: Building the registry also takes work. Each new rule requires model calls and validation builds, and some repairs require extending the applicator with new editing operations. We paid these costs during framework development and rule derivation. Reuse becomes worthwhile when enough cases share a failure to justify that initial effort. A larger registry can reduce repeated diagnosis, but it still needs maintenance as build tools and external resources change.
paragraphs.zh: 构建注册表同样需要投入工作量。 每条新规则都需要模型调用和验证构建，某些修复还需要通过新的编辑操作来扩展应用器。 我们在框架开发和规则推导过程中支付了这些成本。 当足够多的案例共享同一失败模式、足以证明初始投入合理时，复用才变得有价值。 更大的注册表可以减少重复诊断，但随着构建工具和外部资源的变化，它仍然需要维护。

sents.en: Building the registry also takes work.
sents.zh: 构建注册表同样需要投入工作量。

sents.en: Each new rule requires model calls and validation builds, and some repairs require extending the applicator with new editing operations.
sents.zh: 每条新规则都需要模型调用和验证构建，某些修复还需要通过新的编辑操作来扩展应用器。

sents.en: We paid these costs during framework development and rule derivation.
sents.zh: 我们在框架开发和规则推导过程中支付了这些成本。

sents.en: Reuse becomes worthwhile when enough cases share a failure to justify that initial effort.
sents.zh: 当足够多的案例共享同一失败模式、足以证明初始投入合理时，复用才变得有价值。

sents.en: A larger registry can reduce repeated diagnosis, but it still needs maintenance as build tools and external resources change.
sents.zh: 更大的注册表可以减少重复诊断，但随着构建工具和外部资源的变化，它仍然需要维护。

paragraphs.en: The held-out evaluation showed where the registry needed further work: no rule matched 376 of the 400 cases. Deriving another rule is most useful when several cases share a failure. For a failure affecting only one case, an agent may repair the build with less effort than deriving and validating a reusable rule. These limits motivate the division of work in Relay : apply validated rules wherever they match, then escalate what remains.
paragraphs.zh: 留出评估显示了注册表还需要进一步完善的地方：400 个案例中有 376 个没有匹配到任何规则。 当多个案例共享同一个失败时，推导另一条规则才最有用。 对于只影响单个案例的失败，智能体直接修复构建可能比推导并验证一条可复用规则更省力。 这些局限促成了 Relay 中的分工：在所有匹配之处应用已验证的规则，然后将剩余的部分逐级上报。

sents.en: The held-out evaluation showed where the registry needed further work: no rule matched 376 of the 400 cases.
sents.zh: 留出评估显示了注册表还需要进一步完善的地方：400 个案例中有 376 个没有匹配到任何规则。

sents.en: Deriving another rule is most useful when several cases share a failure.
sents.zh: 当多个案例共享同一个失败时，推导另一条规则才最有用。

sents.en: For a failure affecting only one case, an agent may repair the build with less effort than deriving and validating a reusable rule.
sents.zh: 对于只影响单个案例的失败，智能体直接修复构建可能比推导并验证一条可复用规则更省力。

sents.en: These limits motivate the division of work in Relay : apply validated rules wherever they match, then escalate what remains.
sents.zh: 这些局限促成了 Relay 中的分工：在所有匹配之处应用已验证的规则，然后将剩余的部分逐级上报。

paragraphs.en: Our application audit showed that rules sometimes recognized a failure but could not find the text they needed to change. Parsers for package manifests and build instructions could help the applicator make the same edit across different file layouts. The resulting repair would still need to be validated through execution, since a more portable edit could also spread an incorrect change more widely.
paragraphs.zh: 我们的应用审计显示，规则有时能识别出故障，却找不到它们需要修改的文本。 针对包清单和构建指令的解析器可以帮助应用器在不同文件布局中做出相同的编辑。 由此产生的修复仍需通过执行来验证，因为更具可移植性的编辑也可能将错误的更改传播得更广。

sents.en: Our application audit showed that rules sometimes recognized a failure but could not find the text they needed to change.
sents.zh: 我们的应用审计显示，规则有时能识别出故障，却找不到它们需要修改的文本。

sents.en: Parsers for package manifests and build instructions could help the applicator make the same edit across different file layouts.
sents.zh: 针对包清单和构建指令的解析器可以帮助应用器在不同文件布局中做出相同的编辑。

sents.en: The resulting repair would still need to be validated through execution, since a more portable edit could also spread an incorrect change more widely.
sents.zh: 由此产生的修复仍需通过执行来验证，因为更具可移植性的编辑也可能将错误的更改传播得更广。

paragraphs.en: The derivation loop sometimes proposed several versions of the same unsuccessful repair. Keeping a record of the strategies already tried and their execution results could help the model choose a different approach. The framework could also use this history to stop rule derivation or send the case to an agent when repeated proposals fail to restore the build.
paragraphs.zh: 推导循环有时会为同一个失败的修复提出多个版本。 记录已尝试的策略及其执行结果，可以帮助模型选择不同的方法。 当重复的提议无法恢复构建时，该框架还可以利用这一历史记录来停止规则推导，或将该案例交给智能体。

sents.en: The derivation loop sometimes proposed several versions of the same unsuccessful repair.
sents.zh: 推导循环有时会为同一个失败的修复提出多个版本。

sents.en: Keeping a record of the strategies already tried and their execution results could help the model choose a different approach.
sents.zh: 记录已尝试的策略及其执行结果，可以帮助模型选择不同的方法。

sents.en: The framework could also use this history to stop rule derivation or send the case to an agent when repeated proposals fail to restore the build.
sents.zh: 当重复的提议无法恢复构建时，该框架还可以利用这一历史记录来停止规则推导，或将该案例交给智能体。

paragraphs.en: Per-case agents remained useful after the registered rules stopped. They restored 17.5 to 28.1% of the remaining cases. However, more model reasoning cannot recover a missing external resource or correct a failure in the execution infrastructure. The models reported an infrastructure or resource problem in 28 cases, but another model restored 3 of them. The framework should therefore validate the model’s explanation for stopping using the execution logs before deferring a case.
paragraphs.zh: 在注册规则停止后，按案例的智能体仍然有效。 它们恢复了剩余案例中的 17.5% 到 28.1%。 然而，更多的模型推理无法恢复缺失的外部资源，也无法纠正执行基础设施中的故障。 模型在 28 个案例中报告了基础设施或资源问题，但另一个模型恢复了其中的 3 个。 因此，该框架在推迟一个案例之前，应当利用执行日志来验证模型对停止原因的解释。

sents.en: Per-case agents remained useful after the registered rules stopped.
sents.zh: 在注册规则停止后，按案例的智能体仍然有效。

sents.en: They restored 17.5 to 28.1% of the remaining cases.
sents.zh: 它们恢复了剩余案例中的 17.5% 到 28.1%。

sents.en: However, more model reasoning cannot recover a missing external resource or correct a failure in the execution infrastructure.
sents.zh: 然而，更多的模型推理无法恢复缺失的外部资源，也无法纠正执行基础设施中的故障。

sents.en: The models reported an infrastructure or resource problem in 28 cases, but another model restored 3 of them.
sents.zh: 模型在 28 个案例中报告了基础设施或资源问题，但另一个模型恢复了其中的 3 个。

sents.en: The framework should therefore validate the model’s explanation for stopping using the execution logs before deferring a case.
sents.zh: 因此，该框架在推迟一个案例之前，应当利用执行日志来验证模型对停止原因的解释。

paragraphs.en: Improving the agent harness or using stronger models may increase recovery. Many unsuccessful runs reached the token limit, so better evidence selection, conversation management, and tool use could help agents spend their budgets more effectively. Sol did not improve recovery on our small diagnostic subset. Further experiments could test harness changes with the same model and compare models using the same harness.
paragraphs.zh: 改进智能体框架或使用更强的模型可能会提高恢复率。 许多不成功的运行达到了 token 上限，因此更好的证据选择、对话管理和工具使用可以帮助智能体更有效地使用其预算。 Sol 在我们的小型诊断子集上并未提高恢复率。 进一步的实验可以在相同模型下测试框架变更，并在相同框架下比较不同模型。

sents.en: Improving the agent harness or using stronger models may increase recovery.
sents.zh: 改进智能体框架或使用更强的模型可能会提高恢复率。

sents.en: Many unsuccessful runs reached the token limit, so better evidence selection, conversation management, and tool use could help agents spend their budgets more effectively.
sents.zh: 许多不成功的运行达到了 token 上限，因此更好的证据选择、对话管理和工具使用可以帮助智能体更有效地使用其预算。

sents.en: Sol did not improve recovery on our small diagnostic subset.
sents.zh: Sol 在我们的小型诊断子集上并未提高恢复率。

sents.en: Further experiments could test harness changes with the same model and compare models using the same harness.
sents.zh: 进一步的实验可以在相同模型下测试框架变更，并在相同框架下比较不同模型。

paragraphs.en: Benchmark maintainers can reduce future repair work by preserving the resources needed to rebuild each case. Alongside the source revision, they should record base-image digests, dependency revisions, toolchain versions, and build instructions. Where redistribution permits, archiving installers and source packages would also protect against downloads becoming unavailable.
paragraphs.zh: 基准测试的维护者可以通过保存重建每个案例所需的资源，来减少未来的修复工作。 除源码版本外，他们还应记录基础镜像摘要、依赖版本、工具链版本以及构建说明。 在允许再分发的范围内，归档安装程序和源码包还能防范下载资源失效的风险。

sents.en: Benchmark maintainers can reduce future repair work by preserving the resources needed to rebuild each case.
sents.zh: 基准测试的维护者可以通过保存重建每个案例所需的资源，来减少未来的修复工作。

sents.en: Alongside the source revision, they should record base-image digests, dependency revisions, toolchain versions, and build instructions.
sents.zh: 除源码版本外，他们还应记录基础镜像摘要、依赖版本、工具链版本以及构建说明。

sents.en: Where redistribution permits, archiving installers and source packages would also protect against downloads becoming unavailable.
sents.zh: 在允许再分发的范围内，归档安装程序和源码包还能防范下载资源失效的风险。

paragraphs.en: Benchmark maintainers should also preserve build logs, repair chains, and the results of running the recorded input at both revisions. These records let researchers inspect earlier repairs and check whether a restored build still reproduces the historical vulnerability and meets the benchmark-ready criteria.
paragraphs.zh: 基准测试的维护者还应保留构建日志、修复链，以及在两个修订版本上运行所记录输入的结果。 这些记录让研究人员能够检视早期的修复，并检查恢复的构建是否仍能复现历史漏洞以及满足符合基准测试要求的标准。

sents.en: Benchmark maintainers should also preserve build logs, repair chains, and the results of running the recorded input at both revisions.
sents.zh: 基准测试的维护者还应保留构建日志、修复链，以及在两个修订版本上运行所记录输入的结果。

sents.en: These records let researchers inspect earlier repairs and check whether a restored build still reproduces the historical vulnerability and meets the benchmark-ready criteria.
sents.zh: 这些记录让研究人员能够检视早期的修复，并检查恢复的构建是否仍能复现历史漏洞以及满足符合基准测试要求的标准。

paragraphs.en: Attribution. Some cases built successfully on retries without a repair. We therefore report no-patch recoveries separately and use a paired control to check whether repairs were needed. For this reason, we also describe recoveries as rule-associated rather than claiming that every applied rule caused the observed recoveries.
paragraphs.zh: 归因。 一些用例在重试后成功构建，无需修复。 因此，我们将无补丁的恢复单独报告，并使用配对对照来检验是否真的需要修复。 出于这个原因，我们也将恢复描述为与规则相关，而不是断言每条被应用的规则都导致了所观察到的恢复。

sents.en: Attribution.
sents.zh: 归因。

sents.en: Some cases built successfully on retries without a repair.
sents.zh: 一些用例在重试后成功构建，无需修复。

sents.en: We therefore report no-patch recoveries separately and use a paired control to check whether repairs were needed.
sents.zh: 因此，我们将无补丁的恢复单独报告，并使用配对对照来检验是否真的需要修复。

sents.en: For this reason, we also describe recoveries as rule-associated rather than claiming that every applied rule caused the observed recoveries.
sents.zh: 出于这个原因，我们也将恢复描述为与规则相关，而不是断言每条被应用的规则都导致了所观察到的恢复。

paragraphs.en: Campaign comparison. The automated campaign started with the registry developed during the human-guided phase. The phases attempted different cases at different times, and the human-guided work also included framework development. Early selection prioritized promising failure groups, while later selection focused more on underrepresented ecosystems. These differences limit conclusions about how much automation reduced repair time.
paragraphs.zh: 广告活动对比。 自动化广告活动以人类引导阶段期间建立的注册表为起点。 两个阶段在不同时间尝试了不同的案例，而且人类引导的工作还包括框架开发。 早期选择优先考虑有潜力的失败组，而后期的选择则更关注代表性不足的生态系统。 这些差异限制了对自动化在多大程度上减少了修复时间的结论。

sents.en: Campaign comparison.
sents.zh: 广告活动对比。

sents.en: The automated campaign started with the registry developed during the human-guided phase.
sents.zh: 自动化广告活动以人类引导阶段期间建立的注册表为起点。

sents.en: The phases attempted different cases at different times, and the human-guided work also included framework development.
sents.zh: 两个阶段在不同时间尝试了不同的案例，而且人类引导的工作还包括框架开发。

sents.en: Early selection prioritized promising failure groups, while later selection focused more on underrepresented ecosystems.
sents.zh: 早期选择优先考虑有潜力的失败组，而后期的选择则更关注代表性不足的生态系统。

sents.en: These differences limit conclusions about how much automation reduced repair time.
sents.zh: 这些差异限制了对自动化在多大程度上减少了修复时间的结论。

paragraphs.en: Changes between executions. External resources continued to change during the study. Some previously failing cases built successfully without a repair when we re-executed them before RQ3 and RQ4. We excluded these cases because they no longer presented a repair problem. In RQ3, we ran the rule and agent evaluations within one day of each other. These steps reduce, but do not eliminate, differences caused by changes in package repositories, mirrors, and other external services.
paragraphs.zh: 执行之间的变化。 在研究期间，外部资源持续发生变化。 一些之前失败的用例在我们在 RQ3 和 RQ4 之前重新执行时，无需修复即成功构建。 我们排除了这些用例，因为它们不再构成修复问题。 在 RQ3 中，我们在一天之内先后运行了规则评估和智能体评估。 这些步骤可以减少、但无法消除由软件包仓库、镜像和其他外部服务变化所导致的差异。

sents.en: Changes between executions.
sents.zh: 执行之间的变化。

sents.en: External resources continued to change during the study.
sents.zh: 在研究期间，外部资源持续发生变化。

sents.en: Some previously failing cases built successfully without a repair when we re-executed them before RQ3 and RQ4.
sents.zh: 一些之前失败的用例在我们在 RQ3 和 RQ4 之前重新执行时，无需修复即成功构建。

sents.en: We excluded these cases because they no longer presented a repair problem.
sents.zh: 我们排除了这些用例，因为它们不再构成修复问题。

sents.en: In RQ3, we ran the rule and agent evaluations within one day of each other.
sents.zh: 在 RQ3 中，我们在一天之内先后运行了规则评估和智能体评估。

sents.en: These steps reduce, but do not eliminate, differences caused by changes in package repositories, mirrors, and other external services.
sents.zh: 这些步骤可以减少、但无法消除由软件包仓库、镜像和其他外部服务变化所导致的差异。

paragraphs.en: Harness errors. We inspected failed runs to distinguish repair failures from errors in the experimental harness. We report results for all selected cases and additional comparisons excluding runs affected by harness errors. We count patches that fail to apply as repair outcomes. Some errors require judgment to classify, so we may have misclassified cases despite inspecting their logs.
paragraphs.zh: 测试框架错误。 我们检查了失败的运行，以区分修复失败与实验测试框架中的错误。 我们报告所有选定案例的结果，并提供排除受测试框架错误影响的运行后的额外比较。 我们将无法应用的补丁计为修复结果。 某些错误需要主观判断才能分类，因此尽管检查了日志，我们仍可能对部分案例分类有误。

sents.en: Harness errors.
sents.zh: 测试框架错误。

sents.en: We inspected failed runs to distinguish repair failures from errors in the experimental harness.
sents.zh: 我们检查了失败的运行，以区分修复失败与实验测试框架中的错误。

sents.en: We report results for all selected cases and additional comparisons excluding runs affected by harness errors.
sents.zh: 我们报告所有选定案例的结果，并提供排除受测试框架错误影响的运行后的额外比较。

sents.en: We count patches that fail to apply as repair outcomes.
sents.zh: 我们将无法应用的补丁计为修复结果。

sents.en: Some errors require judgment to classify, so we may have misclassified cases despite inspecting their logs.
sents.zh: 某些错误需要主观判断才能分类，因此尽管检查了日志，我们仍可能对部分案例分类有误。

paragraphs.en: Failure and success measures. We count a case as failed when it does not complete the full reconstruction and verification process. This definition includes build failures, unavailable resources, and failures in the execution infrastructure. Some failures may be temporary or have causes unrelated to environment decay. Conversely, a successful build does not by itself restore a vulnerability benchmark. We therefore report crash reproduction and the stricter benchmark-ready outcome separately. These checks do not prove that every behavior of the rebuilt program is unchanged.
paragraphs.zh: 失败与成功的衡量标准。 当一个案例未能完成完整的重建与验证流程时，我们将其计为失败。 该定义包括构建失败、资源不可用以及执行基础设施中的故障。 某些失败可能是临时性的，或其原因与环境衰变无关。 反之，构建成功本身并不能恢复一个漏洞基准。 因此，我们将崩溃复现与更严格的“基准就绪”结果分开报告。 这些检查并不能证明重建后的程序的每一个行为都保持不变。

sents.en: Failure and success measures.
sents.zh: 失败与成功的衡量标准。

sents.en: We count a case as failed when it does not complete the full reconstruction and verification process.
sents.zh: 当一个案例未能完成完整的重建与验证流程时，我们将其计为失败。

sents.en: This definition includes build failures, unavailable resources, and failures in the execution infrastructure.
sents.zh: 该定义包括构建失败、资源不可用以及执行基础设施中的故障。

sents.en: Some failures may be temporary or have causes unrelated to environment decay.
sents.zh: 某些失败可能是临时性的，或其原因与环境衰变无关。

sents.en: Conversely, a successful build does not by itself restore a vulnerability benchmark.
sents.zh: 反之，构建成功本身并不能恢复一个漏洞基准。

sents.en: We therefore report crash reproduction and the stricter benchmark-ready outcome separately.
sents.zh: 因此，我们将崩溃复现与更严格的“基准就绪”结果分开报告。

sents.en: These checks do not prove that every behavior of the rebuilt program is unchanged.
sents.zh: 这些检查并不能证明重建后的程序的每一个行为都保持不变。

paragraphs.en: Grouping and rule credit. Normalized signatures can merge distinct causes or separate variants of one cause. Shared groups motivate investigation but do not guarantee a common repair. Rule credits can overlap within a chain, so we distinguish them from distinct cases. Several rule identifiers may also describe the same repair strategy. Models may misidentify why they stopped, so we check their explanations against the execution evidence.
paragraphs.zh: 分组与规则归因。 归一化后的签名可能把不同的成因合并在一起，或将同一成因的变体分开。 共享分组可以激发排查动机，但并不保证存在共同的修复方法。 规则归因在一条链中可能重叠，因此我们将其与不同案例区分开来。 多个规则标识符也可能描述同一种修复策略。 模型可能错误判断其停止原因，因此我们会将其解释与执行证据进行核对。

sents.en: Grouping and rule credit.
sents.zh: 分组与规则归因。

sents.en: Normalized signatures can merge distinct causes or separate variants of one cause.
sents.zh: 归一化后的签名可能把不同的成因合并在一起，或将同一成因的变体分开。

sents.en: Shared groups motivate investigation but do not guarantee a common repair.
sents.zh: 共享分组可以激发排查动机，但并不保证存在共同的修复方法。

sents.en: Rule credits can overlap within a chain, so we distinguish them from distinct cases.
sents.zh: 规则归因在一条链中可能重叠，因此我们将其与不同案例区分开来。

sents.en: Several rule identifiers may also describe the same repair strategy.
sents.zh: 多个规则标识符也可能描述同一种修复策略。

sents.en: Models may misidentify why they stopped, so we check their explanations against the execution evidence.
sents.zh: 模型可能错误判断其停止原因，因此我们会将其解释与执行证据进行核对。

paragraphs.en: Manual audits. We classified repair operations and repair limits using the available logs and repair specifications. Some earlier records contained less detail, and different rule identifiers sometimes described similar repair strategies. These classifications required judgment, and another researcher might group some operations differently.
paragraphs.zh: 人工审计。 我们利用现有的日志和修复规范对修复操作和修复限制进行了分类。 一些较早的记录包含的细节较少，而且不同的规则标识符有时描述的是相似的修复策略。 这些分类需要主观判断，另一位研究者可能会对某些操作进行不同的归类。

sents.en: Manual audits.
sents.zh: 人工审计。

sents.en: We classified repair operations and repair limits using the available logs and repair specifications.
sents.zh: 我们利用现有的日志和修复规范对修复操作和修复限制进行了分类。

sents.en: Some earlier records contained less detail, and different rule identifiers sometimes described similar repair strategies.
sents.zh: 一些较早的记录包含的细节较少，而且不同的规则标识符有时描述的是相似的修复策略。

sents.en: These classifications required judgment, and another researcher might group some operations differently.
sents.zh: 这些分类需要主观判断，另一位研究者可能会对某些操作进行不同的归类。

paragraphs.en: Costs and budgets. Build executions vary in duration and resource use. Some fail early, while others compile large projects. Token totals count conversation history again each time the harness sends it to the model, and different tokenizers may count the same text differently. Reported model charges exclude hardware and human effort. We report rule derivation costs separately from the cost of applying existing rules. Our cost comparisons therefore cover only part of the total effort needed to develop and run the framework.
paragraphs.zh: 成本与预算。 构建执行在时长和资源使用上各不相同。 有些构建很早就失败，而另一些则要编译大型项目。 令牌总数在每次测试工具向模型发送对话历史时都会重新统计一遍，而不同的分词器对同一段文本的统计结果可能不同。 所报告的模型费用不包含硬件和人力投入。 我们将规则推导成本与应用现有规则的成本分开报告。 因此，我们的成本比较只涵盖开发和运行该框架所需总投入的一部分。

sents.en: Costs and budgets.
sents.zh: 成本与预算。

sents.en: Build executions vary in duration and resource use.
sents.zh: 构建执行在时长和资源使用上各不相同。

sents.en: Some fail early, while others compile large projects.

paragraphs.en: Failure and repair selection. The failure-analysis dataset contains cases for which Relay produced a normalized observation. paragraphs.en: Model repeatability. We ran each model once per case. The local models used temperature 1.0, so repeated runs could produce different results. Both Qwen releases use the same serving settings, but their weights and templates differ. Hosted models may also change over time. We selected the small Sol subset using earlier Qwen outcomes, and many Sol runs reached the token limit. A larger evaluation is needed to assess how model capability affects repair success. Models may also have encountered the public projects and issue reports during training, which could influence their repairs.

paragraphs.en: Prior work has studied how to preserve software builds and reproduce their outputs. Reproducible-build research has examined whether rebuilding the same source produces bit-for-bit identical artifacts ( Lamb and Zacchiroli, 2022 ; Fourné et al., 2023 ; Malka et al., 2025 ) . Studies of container reproducibility have shown that rebuilding can still depend on changing image tags, package repositories, and external downloads ( Malka et al., 2026 ) . Researchers have addressed environment preservation through functional package managers ( Malka et al., 2024 ) and developed systems to reconstruct dependencies for Python programs and notebooks ( Horton and Parnin, 2019 ; Ye et al., 2022 ; Wang et al., 2021 ) . We examined how to restore historical builds across several ecosystems after their environments had stopped working.
paragraphs.zh: 已有工作研究了如何保存软件构建并复现其输出。 可复现构建研究考察了重新构建同一源代码是否能产生逐位一致的制品（Lamb and Zacchiroli, 2022; Fourné et al., 2023; Malka et al., 2025）。 关于容器可复现性的研究表明，重新构建仍可能依赖于不断变化的镜像标签、软件包仓库和外部下载（Malka et al., 2026）。 研究者通过函数式包管理器解决环境保存问题（Malka et al., 2024），并开发了为 Python 程序和笔记本重建依赖的系统（Horton and Parnin, 2019; Ye et al., 2022; Wang et al., 2021）。 我们研究了在多个生态系统的环境失效之后，如何恢复其历史构建。

paragraphs.en: Research on executable defect datasets has highlighted the need to preserve historical build environments. Defects4J, BugSwarm, and Vul4J provided historical failures for controlled experimentation ( Just et al., 2014 ; Tomassi et al., 2019 ; Bui et al., 2022 ) , while Zhu and Rubio-González showed that dataset artifacts could lose reproducibility over time ( Zhu and Rubio-González, 2023 ) . ARVO addressed this problem for OSS-Fuzz vulnerabilities by reconstructing vulnerable and fixed revisions ( Mei et al., 2026 ) . CyberGym and SEC-bench subsequently used executable historical software to evaluate security agents ( Wang et al., 2026 ; Lee et al., 2025 ) . We extended ARVO to repair the environment failures that remained after its reconstruction mechanisms ran. This also distinguished our work from systems such as CodeRover-S, which repaired vulnerabilities by changing the target source ( Zhang et al., 2026 ) whereas we preserved that source and repaired the environment needed to build and execute it.
paragraphs.zh: 关于可执行缺陷数据集的研究凸显了保留历史构建环境的必要性。 Defect4J、BugSwarm 和 Vul4J 为受控实验提供了历史失败案例（Just 等，2014；Tomassi 等，2019；Bui 等，2022），而 Zhu 和 Rubio-González 则表明数据集产物可能随时间推移失去可复现性（Zhu 和 Rubio-González，2023）。 ARVO 通过重建易受攻击版本和已修复版本来解决 OSS-Fuzz 漏洞中的这一问题（Mei 等，2026）。 CyberGym 和 SEC-bench 随后使用可执行的历史软件来评估安全智能体（Wang 等，2026；Lee 等，2025）。 我们扩展了 ARVO，以修复其重建机制运行后仍然存在的环境故障。 这也将我们的工作与 CodeRover-S 等系统区分开来，后者通过更改目标源码来修复漏洞（Zhang 等，2026），而我们则保留该源码并修复构建和执行它所需的环境。

paragraphs.en: Several studies have investigated build failures and their repair across continuous integration, Docker, and other build systems ( Rausch et al., 2017 ; Vassallo et al., 2017 ; Wu et al., 2020 ; Lou et al., 2020 ) . A prior study by Nourry et al. also studied active OSS-Fuzz projects and identified failure causes across project source, build scripts, dependencies, toolchains, external resources, and execution infrastructure ( Nourry et al., 2025 ) . These findings motivated us to examine repairs across several stages of a build. We focused on historical revisions, where changing the target source could alter the benchmark case, and investigated whether environment repairs could be reused across versions and projects.
paragraphs.zh: 多项研究考察了持续集成、Docker 及其他构建系统中的构建失败及其修复（Rausch et al., 2017；Vassallo et al., 2017；Wu et al., 2020；Lou et al., 2020）。 Nourry et al. 此前的研究还研究了活跃的 OSS-Fuzz 项目，并识别了项目源码、构建脚本、依赖、工具链、外部资源和执行基础设施等方面的失败原因（Nourry et al., 2025）。 这些发现促使我们考察构建多个阶段的修复。 我们聚焦于历史版本，因为修改目标源码可能会改变基准测试用例，并考察环境修复能否在不同版本和项目之间复用。

paragraphs.en: Researchers have also developed tools to automate build repair using project history, dependency fixes, and reusable editing operations. HireBuild used earlier changes to repair build scripts ( Hassan and Wang, 2018 ) , while later work examined the limits of relying on history and proposed repairs that did not require it ( Lou et al., 2019 ) . Dependency-focused systems included BuildMedic for Maven builds ( Macho et al., 2018 ) and PyDFix for Python dependency errors ( Mukherjee et al., 2021 ) . Reusable operations have also supported Dockerfile repair through human-guided derivation ( Henkel et al., 2021 ) and mined patterns ( Sakamoto and Ohira, 2026 ) . Other work has addressed flaky Docker builds and equipped agents with operations for Android build repair ( Shabani et al., 2025 ; Son et al., 2026 ) . These approaches have developed repair mechanisms for specific build technologies and ecosystems. Alternatively, we examined how to derive and reuse repairs across the containers, dependencies, resources, toolchains, and scripts involved in historical reconstruction.

paragraphs.en: Program-repair research has also investigated how to reuse fixes. Refazer learned syntactic transformations from examples ( Rolim et al., 2017 ) , and Getafix learned fix patterns from human-written changes ( Bader et al., 2019 ) . These systems showed how examples could guide repairs beyond the original case. We applied this idea to build environments by asking an LLM to derive rules from representative failures. We tested each candidate by rebuilding cases, then reused accepted rules without further model calls.

paragraphs.en: Recent studies have used language-model agents to automate repository setup, compilation, and test execution ( Hu et al., 2025b ; Bouzenia and Pradel, 2025 ; Milliken et al., 2025 ; Hu et al., 2025a ; Yu et al., 2025 ) . EnvBench has provided tasks for evaluating environment setup in Python and JVM projects ( Eliseeva et al., 2025 ) . Much of this work has focused on preparing repositories for execution. RepoRescue examined a setting closer to ours: older Python and Java repositories that no longer worked in modern environments ( Lin et al., 2026 ) . It allowed source changes and evaluated success through historical tests. We preserved the target source revision and used the recorded crashing input to check historical behavior. Other studies have used agents or LLM-generated patches to repair dependency-related build failures ( Macho et al., 2026 ; Reyes et al., 2026 ) .
paragraphs.zh: 近期研究已使用语言模型智能体来自动化仓库设置、编译和测试执行（Hu et al., 2025b; Bouzenia and Pradel, 2025; Milliken et al., 2025; Hu et al., 2025a; Yu et al., 2025）。 EnvBench 提供了用于评估 Python 和 JVM 项目环境搭建的任务（Eliseeva et al., 2025）。 这项工作大多聚焦于为执行准备仓库。 RepoRescue 研究了一个更接近我们工作的场景：在现代环境中已无法运行的较旧的 Python 和 Java 仓库（Lin et al., 2026）。 该工作允许修改源代码，并通过历史测试来评估成功与否。 我们保留了目标源代码版本，并使用记录下来的崩溃输入来检验历史行为。 另一些研究使用智能体或 LLM 生成的补丁来修复与依赖相关的构建失败（Macho et al., 2026; Reyes et al., 2026）。

paragraphs.en: Recent work has explored how agents could reuse knowledge from earlier setup tasks. SetupX transferred structured experience between repositories, while BootstrapAgent recorded verified setup knowledge for later agents ( Zhou et al., 2026 ; Fu et al., 2026 ) . We pursued reuse through executable repair rules. Once a rule passed validation, the framework could apply it to matching failures without another model call. Per-case agents handled cases that remained unresolved.
paragraphs.zh: 近期工作已探索了智能体如何复用早期配置任务中的知识。 SetupX 在代码仓库之间传递结构化经验，而 BootstrapAgent 为后续智能体记录经过验证的配置知识（Zhou et al., 2026；Fu et al., 2026）。 我们通过可执行的修复规则来实现复用。 一旦某条规则通过验证，框架便可将其应用于匹配的失败情形，而无需再次调用模型。 逐案例智能体则处理仍未解决的案例。

paragraphs.en: These studies have advanced reusable repair and per-case environment setup. We brought the two approaches together for historical build restoration and evaluated where each helped. Our comparison examined their recovery, build effort, model use, and the cases they restored. Combining the recorded outcomes let us assess the benefit of applying existing rules before spending agent effort on unresolved cases.
paragraphs.zh: 这些研究推进了可复用修复和针对具体案例的环境搭建。 我们将这两种方法结合用于历史构建恢复，并评估了各自在哪些方面有所帮助。 我们的比较考察了它们的恢复能力、构建工作量、模型使用情况以及所恢复的案例。 合并已记录的结果让我们能够评估在为未解决案例投入智能体精力之前，先应用现有规则的收益。

paragraphs.en: We examined 14,159 historical OSS-Fuzz cases and found that 69.7% failed to complete reconstruction and verification despite pinned source revisions. The failures were concentrated: 161 groups covered 71.0% of the failure-analysis dataset. These recurring failures created opportunities to reuse repairs across cases.
paragraphs.zh: 我们分析了 14,159 个历史 OSS-Fuzz 案例，发现尽管锁定了源码版本，仍有 69.7% 的案例无法完成重建与验证。 这些失败高度集中：161 个组覆盖了失败分析数据集的 71.0%。 这些反复出现的失败为跨案例复现修复创造了机会。

paragraphs.en: We developed Relay to derive reusable repair rules and escalate unresolved cases to per-case agents. Across the campaigns, 52 rules contributed to 469 recoveries. On the 50 cases in our paired evaluation, agents restored similar numbers of builds but required 2.3 to 3.6 times as many build executions per recovery. Combining the recorded outcomes gave 37 to 39 recoveries with fewer builds and less than half the agent tokens of an agent alone. Agents also restored 17.5 to 28.1% of the cases left unresolved by deterministic repair. These findings support applying reusable rules first and using agents for the remaining cases.
paragraphs.zh: 我们开发了 Relay，用于提炼可复用的修复规则，并将未解决的案例升级给逐案例的智能体。 在这些活动中，52 条规则促成了 469 次恢复。 在我们配对评估的 50 个案例上，智能体恢复了相近数量的构建，但每次恢复所需的构建执行次数是前者的 2.3 到 3.6 倍。 将记录的结果相结合，得到了 37 到 39 次恢复，构建次数更少，且智能体令牌用量不到单独使用智能体时的一半。 智能体还恢复了确定性修复未能解决的案例中的 17.5% 到 28.1%。 这些发现支持优先应用可复用规则，并对剩余案例使用智能体。

paragraphs.en: Further work could improve how rules edit different build-file layouts and how agents use their execution and token budgets. Experiments could also vary the execution evidence given to rule-authoring models and repair agents to determine which logs, error excerpts, and repair history help them make better repairs. Evaluating stronger models with the same harness would help identify where model capability improves recovery. Throughout restoration, checking the recorded historical behavior remains essential to preserving the cases used by vulnerability benchmarks.
paragraphs.zh: 后续工作可以改进规则如何编辑不同的构建文件布局，以及智能体如何使用它们的执行和令牌预算。 实验还可以改变提供给规则撰写模型和修复智能体的执行证据，以确定哪些日志、错误摘录和修复历史能帮助它们做出更好的修复。 使用同一测试框架评估更强的模型，有助于确定模型能力在哪些方面能改善恢复效果。 在整个还原过程中，检查所记录的历史行为对于保留漏洞基准所使用的用例仍然至关重要。

It contains case manifests, normalized failure observations, and data and analysis scripts for reproducing the main quantitative results. The package documents which results the scripts reproduce. We will release the full package upon publication, including the complete rule registry, repair records, prompts, and model responses.
